축제소개: The Herbstfest Kloster Veßra is an annual lifestyle and garden fair that transforms the historic grounds of the Henneberg Museum Kloster Veßra into an autumn-inspired world of experiences. Organized by Arcos GmbH, this event uniquely combines tradition with contemporary trends, nature with indulgence, and craftsmanship with lifestyle. Each year in September, as the vibrant colors of autumn unfold, the festival invites visitors to experience the special atmosphere of one of Thuringia’s most beautiful open-air museums. The listed walls of the former Cistercian monastery provide a striking backdrop for a fair that is far more than a typical market – it is a stylish celebration for garden enthusiasts, food lovers, families, and curious explorers alike. The event centers around themes related to home, garden, and rural living, always reflecting the region’s artisanal and agricultural heritage. Visitors can discover seasonal plants such as roses, herbs, and perennials, accompanied by expert advice and practical care tips. The selection is complemented by thoughtfully curated products for stylish living – from handmade decorations and rustic-elegant furniture to distinctive fashion pieces, including Italian designer wear and high-quality alpaca wool clothing. Jewelry and trendy accessories further enrich the diverse range on offer. Culinary highlights include a delightful mix of regional specialties and international delicacies. Special features such as whisky tastings and gourmet food stands with unique offerings provide additional culinary experiences. Exhibitors mainly come from the fields of horticulture, crafts, design, home décor, fashion, fine foods, and natural products. The audience is just as diverse, drawing visitors from across Thuringia, Franconia, Hesse, and beyond. Garden lovers, connoisseurs, families, and professionals from the floristry, decoration, and event industries particularly value the successful blend of quality, atmosphere, and regional flair. The venue – the Henneberg Museum Kloster Veßra – is a cultural landmark in southern Thuringia. Its impressive architecture and picturesque surroundings give the event a truly one-of-a-kind setting. Getting there is easy: by car via the A71 motorway, or by public transport to the nearby Themar train station, from which shuttle services run to the event grounds.

The kulinart Frankfurt is an annual public and trade fair held in autumn, established as a platform for culinary culture, sustainable food, and stylish lifestyle design. It is organized by Frankfurter Messe & Event GmbH, an experienced event organizer based in Offenbach. The venue is the Casino building on the Westend Campus of Goethe University Frankfurt – an architecturally striking location on one of the most beautiful university campuses in Europe. This elegant setting provides the ideal backdrop for an event dedicated to mindful enjoyment, regional diversity, and artisanal craftsmanship. More than just a trade fair, kulinart is a sensory experience that appeals to food lovers, amateur chefs, health-conscious visitors, and design enthusiasts alike. It showcases a carefully curated selection of high-quality foods, innovative culinary products, stylish kitchenware, and contemporary ideas for table culture and home living. At its core is a commitment to quality, sustainability, and individuality. Whether organic, fair-trade, or locally produced, conscious consumption becomes a journey of discovery. The focus is on culinary trends and authentic taste experiences. Visitors discover products rarely found in conventional retail stores: fine oils, unusual vinegars, handcrafted chocolates, unique spreads, aromatic spices, fresh truffles, rare mushrooms, and much more. The selection is complemented by exquisite wines – especially from Hessian winemakers in the Rheingau and Hessische Bergstraße regions – as well as artisanal sparkling wines and champagnes, distinctive craft beers, and fine spirits such as gin, whisky, and fruit brandies from small distilleries. A local specialty, apple wine, is also featured in a wide range of variations. A key emphasis of the fair is on regional origins and artisanal production. Many exhibitors come from Hesse or neighboring areas and present products made with attention to detail and traditional methods. From cheeses from small farm dairies to specialty sausages from family-run butcheries and individually brewed craft beers – culinary craftsmanship is on display at its finest. Kulinart also offers an interactive experience with live cooking shows, tastings, and workshops. On the show stage, renowned chefs and food bloggers share practical tips, present recipes, and invite the audience to think along, cook along, and sample their creations. Themed tasting zones and high-quality street food make the fair a place where culinary diversity can be experienced in all its forms – from quick bites to in-depth professional exchanges. Kulinart Frankfurt is a source of inspiration for anyone who values conscious enjoyment, sustainable products, and authentic cuisine – all within a refined setting that encourages personal encounters. Seamlessly combining marketplace, trade fair, and experiential event, it has earned a firm place in the region’s event calendar thanks to its clear focus on quality, local character, and craftsmanship.

WeinDortmund is a distinguished wine fair that has established itself as an annual event for both trade professionals and the general public at the prestigious Westphalian Industrial Club in Dortmund. Organized by the experienced Webermesse GmbH, it invites guests each year on a flavorful journey through the world of wine. The focus is on red Burgundy varieties, which pair perfectly with seasonal autumn cuisine, as well as freshly bottled wines from the current vintage. Alongside new product releases, the fair also showcases the personal signatures and unique styles of the winemakers. The event is clearly curated: more than 500 wines from renowned German wine regions – including the Moselle, Nahe, Franconia, Rheinhessen, Palatinate, Baden, and Württemberg – as well as international selections from Italy, Spain, France, Austria, Australia, South Africa, and Chile are available for tasting. Visitors can engage directly with winemakers, wineries, cooperatives, and importers to gain deeper insight into the origins and philosophies behind each wine. WeinDortmund is much more than a traditional tasting event. It serves as an exclusive platform for trade professionals, upscale gastronomy, and discerning wine enthusiasts who not only sample but also place orders on site. Exhibitors from wine production, import/export, specialized retail, hospitality, and wine and beverage technology use the fair strategically to establish new business contacts, launch products, and showcase their brands in a premium environment. As part of Webermesse GmbH’s exclusive event portfolio, WeinDortmund is also held in selected cities such as Berlin, Cologne, and Munich – with each edition tailored to the local audience and regional culinary culture. The Westphalian Industrial Club offers not only an elegant and centrally located venue, but also excellent accessibility thanks to its proximity to the main train station, public transport, and convenient parking – making it easily reachable for both regional visitors and guests from across Germany. WeinDortmund combines in-depth wine expertise with urban hospitality – a must-attend event for anyone who wants to experience wine with all their senses.

전시회명: Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato
축제소개: The “Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato” is a nationally significant culinary and cultural fair held annually since 1985 in the picturesque town of Sant’Agata Feltria, nestled in Italy’s Emilia-Romagna region. Every October, the Strada Provinciale Santagatese and the town’s historic center are transformed into a vibrant stage for flavors, traditions, and craftsmanship. Organized by the Comune di Sant’Agata Feltria, the fair is not merely a culinary event, but a deliberate tribute to the region’s cultural roots and natural richness. Amidst medieval architecture, gourmets, producers, chefs, farmers, travelers, and truffle enthusiasts gather for a celebration of all the senses. At the heart of the event is the prized white truffle – a delicacy foraged in the surrounding woodlands with the help of specially trained dogs. Available only seasonally, this aromatic tuber is much more than a regional specialty: it is a symbol of local identity and cultural heritage. Since 2021, the art of truffle hunting and harvesting has been recognized by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage – a status brought to life at the fair through themed events, demonstrations, and informative exhibits. Yet, the Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato goes far beyond showcasing truffles. It blends culinary excellence with traditional crafts, cultural exchange, and a diverse program of events. Visitors can expect a welcoming atmosphere shaped by regional cuisine, exhibitions, live music, guided tours, and hands-on workshops – all infused with the warm hospitality of the local community. A particular crowd favorite is the truffle dog competition, where humans and animals team up in a friendly contest to demonstrate their skills in finding the "white gold". Meanwhile, wine tours to local vineyards and inventive truffle-based dishes in the town’s restaurants offer indulgent experiences for food lovers. The fair attracts professionals from the culinary arts, agriculture, food production, hospitality, and retail sectors, as well as private visitors, travel groups, families, and gourmet travelers. Visiting the fair is not only a journey into the world of truffles but also an encounter with history and culture. Landmarks such as the Rocca Fregoso, the Angelo Mariani Theatre, ornate fountains, and historic monasteries create a striking backdrop with a unique atmosphere. The town is easily accessible by car or public transport and welcomes guests with autumnal colors, fragrant alleyways, and unmistakable charm. The Fiera Nazionale del Tartufo Bianco Pregiato is a celebration for all senses, a tribute to regional authenticity, and a shining example of how culinary excellence, sustainable values, and living traditions can come together in inspiring harmony.

The Bern Wine Fair, a combination of trade and public exhibition, has been celebrating an annual homage to the world of wines and culinary delights since its inception in 1974. Over the course of ten days, BERNEXPO, the renowned exhibition center in Bern, transforms into a paradise for wine lovers and gourmets. This exquisite event is organized by Berner Weinmesse AG. The heart of the fair is the Oenotheque, where more than 2,000 exquisite wines from around the world are showcased by expert dealers in a relaxed atmosphere. Visitors have the opportunity to engage directly with winemakers and wineries, gaining in-depth knowledge about the wines on offer. The Oenotheque provides a unique chance to discover and taste new and award-winning wine creations. Another highlight is the selection of cult wines, where exclusive and world-famous wines such as Château Mouton Rothschild and Redigaffi Toscana IGT are available for tasting. This special selection emphasizes the distinctive character of the Bern Wine Fair and offers connoisseurs deep insights into the elite of the wine world. In addition, regional delicacies, spirits, and specialty beers are featured, showcasing the culinary diversity of the region and beyond. This gastronomic offering complements the experience, allowing visitors to meet local producers in person and hear their stories. The Bern Wine Fair is not only known for its wide range of themes and highlights, but also for its focus on fostering dialogue and exchange between wine enthusiasts and producers. As a meeting and tasting venue, it provides a platform for independent winemakers, family-owned wineries, distillers, and wine cooperatives to present their latest products and recommendations to a broad audience. Throughout its long history, the Bern Wine Fair has established itself as an indispensable event on the calendar of every wine lover. The fair takes place in the impressive setting of BERNEXPO, which stands out not only for its central location but also for its modern facilities and welcoming atmosphere. Every year, this event attracts thousands of national and international visitors who share a common passion for wine and gastronomy.

The "Speis & Trank" fair in Fellbach, organized by M&S Messebau & Service GmbH, is an annual highlight for lovers of exquisite food and drink cultures. With its unique concept, the fair presents a carefully curated selection of international and local delights in the impressive setting of the Alte Kelter, a historic building located in the heart of Fellbach, near Stuttgart. With space for around 100 exhibitors, "Speis & Trank" offers an inspiring culinary journey through the latest trends in gastronomy. Visitors can explore and purchase everything from handmade spreads to premium wines and high-quality gourmet products. The fair successfully brings together a wide range of products and services, making it a must-attend event for any food connoisseur. A particular highlight is the variety of tasting opportunities, allowing guests to discover new flavors on-site. The culinary offerings are complemented by a selection of refreshing drinks and light snacks, all of which can be enjoyed in the charming atmosphere of the Alte Kelter. Beautifully decorated seating areas invite visitors to linger and savor the experience. The Alte Kelter itself adds to the event's special charm with its unique architecture and historical significance. Centrally located in Fellbach, it is easily accessible by public transport, and for those arriving by car, ample parking is available at the nearby Max-Graser Stadium. With its combination of international diversity, regional quality, a unique venue, and a broad range of products and experiences, the "Speis & Trank" fair stands out from other events. It is a must-visit for anyone who loves food and drink. The fair provides a platform for both exhibitors and visitors to immerse themselves in the world of culinary arts while also experiencing the rich culture and history of Fellbach.

The "Food Expo", an annual international trade fair for food and beverages, takes place at the International Exhibition Center in Kyiv, Ukraine. As an integral part of the International Forum for Food Industry and Packaging (IFFIP), it has evolved into the leading platform for the food sector in Ukraine. Organized by the Kyiv International Contract Fair, it regularly brings together a multitude of manufacturers, producers, suppliers, and traders from the relevant industry. At the "Food Expo", national, international, and regional exhibitors offer a comprehensive range of products and services. This includes meat, fish, cheese, dairy products, coffee, tea, juices, water, cereals, baked goods, and fruits and vegetables. Special attention is given to extraordinary creations and specialties of various flavors. The fair provides international and new brands access to the Ukrainian market and supports established companies in increasing their brand recognition, generating new business, and maintaining existing business relationships. The "Food Expo" is closely linked with the city of Kyiv and the country of Ukraine, reflecting the cultural diversity and gastronomic wealth of the region. In addition to the product variety, various business events are highlights of the fair, promoting networking among participants and providing insights into new developments and future perspectives of the industry. Exhibitors and visitors of the "Food Expo" come from a variety of sectors within the food and beverage industry, including: meat and fish industry, dairy industry, beverage industry, bakery and confectionery, fruit and vegetable processing, dietary supplements and health foods, packaging industry, food technology and equipment. This wide range of sectors allows the "Food Expo" to present a comprehensive picture of current trends, products, and innovations in the food and beverage industry. In summary, the "Food Expo" plays a significant role in the food and beverage industry due to its extensive offerings and easy accessibility. The modern infrastructure of the International Exhibition Center in Kyiv further enhances the importance of this fair.

The Good Food & Wine Show Brisbane is an annual culinary event that has established itself as a special highlight for food lovers and connoisseurs. Since joining the national event series in 2005, it has been held at the Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre (BCEC), a modern venue located in the heart of South Bank – the city’s cultural and gastronomic hub. With its excellent infrastructure and central location, the BCEC provides the perfect setting for a show that combines fine food and drink with entertainment, education, and direct encounters with producers. The show was first launched in Melbourne in 2001 and quickly developed into a nationwide success. Today, it forms part of a series of events also hosted in Sydney, Melbourne, and Perth. It is organized by Diversified Exhibitions Australia, an experienced event company specializing in both trade and consumer formats, with a focus on connecting industries, opening up markets, and showcasing innovation. The Good Food & Wine Show Brisbane appeals to both passionate consumers and industry professionals. Rather than serving primarily as a sales platform, it presents itself as a multisensory experience that celebrates food, drink, and culinary culture. At its core are the opportunities to connect directly with producers, experience culinary processes live, and gain knowledge in an engaging and entertaining way. One of the show’s main attractions is the series of live cooking demonstrations featuring well-known Australian chefs. These sessions not only showcase culinary skill but also offer audiences practical tips and personal insights into each chef’s philosophy. Another highlight is the Wine & Beverage Zone, where visitors can taste premium wines, craft beers, ciders, and spirits while speaking directly with winemakers and producers. The focus goes beyond individual products, highlighting entire wine regions such as the Barossa Valley, Margaret River, McLaren Vale, and the Granite Belt, each with its own geographic, cultural, and tourism identity. The event also features a wide selection of street food, gourmet products, cheese, chocolate, and delicacies. Guests can enhance their experience by joining paid masterclasses and workshops led by experts, covering topics such as wine pairing, cocktail making, and advanced cooking techniques. Visitors also have the chance to meet culinary personalities in person, collecting autographs and photos during post-show meet-and-greets. A distinctive element of the show is the strong involvement of food artisans and producers, who share insights into their craft, explain production processes, and communicate the philosophy behind their products. This direct exchange creates an authentic experience and emphasizes the event’s focus on quality, regional identity, and innovation. More than just a consumer fair, the Good Food & Wine Show Brisbane is an interactive celebration of taste that brings together gastronomy, learning, and entertainment at a high level – an annual highlight for anyone who not only enjoys food and drink, but also wants to understand, experience, and share them.

TERRAVINI is an annual celebration of culinary delight held in the heart of the Côte d’Azur, specifically at the Palais Nikaia in Nice. Dedicated to the finest products from land and sea, the event brings together food lovers, producers, and industry professionals in a distinctive and inviting atmosphere. The name TERRAVINI is derived from the Latin words terra (earth) and vini (wine), reflecting the core mission of the event: to honor regional culinary treasures born of soil, water, and vine. Organized by SAVIM EXPO SARL, TERRAVINI serves as a platform for authentic products and artisanal quality. It welcomes both private gourmets and trade visitors from the hospitality, fine food, and beverage industries. At its heart, the fair features premium wines, champagne, fine spirits, craft beers, regional produce, freshwater and seafood delicacies, exquisite chocolates, confectionery, and gourmet specialties. Many of these products are available for on-site tasting, both hot and cold. Exhibitors – including winemakers, distillers, chocolatiers, fishermen, bakers, and delicatessen producers – come primarily from France and offer genuine insights into their craft. TERRAVINI is far more than a sales exhibition. Tastings, product presentations, culinary competitions, and awards turn a visit into a memorable experience. The regional character is ever-present – Nice and Provence not only inspire the event but are also the source of many of the showcased specialties. The fair offers a feast for the senses while providing a well-organized venue for networking, inspiration, and the discovery of exceptional products. Located close to Nice Côte d’Azur Airport and well connected to public transport, the modern Palais Nikaia provides the perfect setting for this celebration of flavor, authenticity, and regional passion.

The 'Food Experience Taiwan' in Taipei is a trade fair dedicated to the allure and diversity of French gourmet products, wines, spirits, and kitchenware. Situated in the bustling heart of POPOP, it provides an impressive platform for exhibitors to showcase the crème de la crème of their products from France. The event is divided into two main sections: an exhibition hall where visitors can explore a multitude of stalls and discover the latest culinary creations from France, and an exclusive workshop area that invites in-depth culinary exchange. These workshops, led by renowned French gourmet experts, create an intimate setting for up to 50 participants. Here, they have the opportunity not only to learn about the unique features of French delicacies but also to witness firsthand how these products are demonstrated in culinary presentations and seminars. The fair's objective is to establish a connection between French culinary culture and the professionals of the food and beverage industry in Taiwan. Hence, representatives from cafes, hotels, restaurants, and even the agricultural and food industry are invited to participate. This annual gathering leads to the introduction of new French ingredients and products which are showcased not only to industry professionals but also to the general public in a specially organized press conference. It offers an excellent opportunity for Taiwanese media and influential personalities to get firsthand information about the latest trends from France. In summary, the 'Food Experience Taiwan' is not just a fair – it's a culinary voyage that brings the best of France directly to Taipei. An event that offers both exhibitors and visitors an unforgettable experience year after year.

The Plaza Culinaria in Freiburg im Breisgau, an annual pleasure fair held in November, is considered one of the most outstanding culinary events in Germany. Since its inception in 2004 by the Freiburg Wirtschaft Touristik und Messe GmbH & Co. KG, the fair has evolved into a true festival for all the senses, attracting both visitors and exhibitors who wish to celebrate the finer things in life. The fair is a haven for gourmets, offering a wide range of products and services. These include non-alcoholic beverages, organic delicacies, craft beers from local breweries, international delicacies and specialties, innovative gastronomy & catering services, as well as enticing offerings of coffee, tea, chocolate, pastries, and confectionery. For those interested in the culture of cooking, Plaza Culinaria showcases the latest trends in kitchen culture and related accessories. Additionally, areas such as culinary travel, themed literature, and home & living enhance the experience. Special attention is also given to sustainable living, with a variety of products for vegetarians and vegans. The "Christmas Magic" is another highlight of the fair, introducing a new themed area called "Trends & Lifestyle," encompassing everything from decorations to seasonal delicacies. Not to be overlooked is the selection of wines, sparkling wines, and spirits, appreciated by connoisseurs and novices alike. The event takes place at Messe Freiburg, a venue known for its modern facilities and its ability to accommodate a wide array of events. This location does not only provide ample space for the numerous exhibitors and visitors but also offers a pleasant atmosphere that encourages lingering, discovering, and indulging. In addition to the extensive range of exhibitors, Plaza Culinaria ensures an exciting supporting program with culinary entertainment highlights. These include live cooking shows, tastings led by industry experts, and workshops that give visitors the opportunity to learn directly from professionals. Overall, Plaza Culinaria is an experience that invites you to explore and celebrate the world of culinary delights with all your senses. It represents a combination of quality, diversity, and entertainment, thereby solidifying its status as one of the unmissable events for culinary enthusiasts.

Wein & More is much more than a traditional trade fair – it’s a delightful experience that takes place twice a year in the stylish setting of the Bürgerhaus Neukeferloh, located in the district of the same name within the municipality of Grassbrunn near Munich. As both a trade and public event, it caters equally to industry professionals – including sommeliers, restaurateurs, winemakers, and merchants – as well as to wine enthusiasts and food lovers from the region and beyond. Organized by Ingo Raibold, Wein & More serves as a platform for high-quality indulgence, personal exchange, and professional inspiration. Over the course of two days, the Bürgerhaus Neukeferloh transforms into a hub of culinary discovery: national and international exhibitors showcase their latest wine creations, premium spirits, fine cheeses and chocolates, gourmet foods, and other delicacies. At the heart of the event are quality, authenticity, and direct interaction between producers and visitors – a hallmark that gives the fair its unique character. The concept centers on creating a rich experience with added value. In addition to traditional tastings, visitors can enjoy a thoughtfully curated supporting program featuring workshops, seminars, expert talks, and culinary shows. Specialists from the wine and gourmet industries share up-to-date knowledge on topics such as wine storage, sensory analysis, and food pairing, offer insights into current trends, and are available for personal discussions. This combination of information, inspiration, and sensory enjoyment makes Wein & More a key event for anyone with a professional or personal interest in wine and fine food. Thanks to its biannual schedule, visitors have regular access to seasonal highlights and the latest innovations in the industry. The Bürgerhaus Neukeferloh provides the ideal setting for this – modern, spacious facilities with high-quality furnishings and a pleasant atmosphere that perfectly reflects the event’s emphasis on style and indulgence. Wein & More is not just a showcase for premium products – it’s a social event that brings together people who appreciate quality and taste, while offering direct connections to the creators behind the brands.

The FoodExpo Kazakhstan, formerly also known as Worldfood Kazakhstan, is a prominent trade fair in the Asian region, contributing since its inception in 1998 to the presentation of trends, products, and technologies in food production and marketing on an international platform. The expo, taking place annually at the Atakent International Exhibition Centre in Almaty, has established itself as an effective platform for introducing new products and networking with industry experts from the global food industry. The fair is organized by Iteca Almaty, an experienced organizer, which has shaped the FoodExpo into a crucial platform for companies from all over the world to present their products and services to a wide audience. With main themes extending across food and beverages, ingredients, food technology, baked goods, packaging, and agriculture, the expo offers a comprehensive range that spans from food to production and packaging equipment, through to agricultural topics and discussions. The AgriFood Forum is a special highlight of the FoodExpo, addressing issues such as animal husbandry, feed production, and efficient gardening. Here, professionals from various sectors have the opportunity to exchange ideas, expand networks, and discuss current challenges and innovations in the industry. In addition to the forum, the FoodExpo also hosts the competition and award "The Best Product of FoodExpo Qazaqstan," which serves as a prestigious event within the fair and honors innovative products. Exhibitors from various industries such as food production, retail and wholesale, catering, and packaging present their products and services at the fair. Visitors, primarily from manufacturing, trade, catering, and distribution sectors, can discover a variety of products and technologies, which include food, beverages, equipment, additives, packaging, transport solutions, and numerous other subject areas. The fair not only strengthens the relationship between national and international players in the food industry but also offers an excellent opportunity to showcase the diversity and quality of the Kazakh food sector. Almaty, being one of the largest cities in Kazakhstan and a significant economic center, provides an optimally accessible location for national and international guests with the Atakent International Exhibition Centre. This exhibition center is not only a hub for international business activities but also symbolizes Kazakhstan's openness towards global markets and trends. It is easily accessible by both public transport and car and offers comprehensive facilities and services for exhibitors and visitors alike. Thus, the FoodExpo Kazakhstan forms a comprehensive, culturally, and economically significant event, promoting the exchange and presentation of innovations in the food industry and acting as a bridge between local and international market participants.

The MIF Expo in Paris, established in 2012, is regarded as the premier showcase for French products and services that represent the exclusive French lifestyle. Behind the acronym MIF lies the term "Made in France". This designation reflects both the main philosophy and the core focus of the fair. It opens its doors annually at the prestigious Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and attracts both visitors and exhibitors from all over France and beyond. The firm ADEL SAS – Salon MIF Expo, which specializes in presenting high-quality, innovative, and quintessentially French products and services, is responsible for its organization and execution. At the heart of the MIF Expo is the introduction of the diversity and excellence of products and services that proudly bear the "Made in France" label. The range on offer spans from fashion and accessories to gastronomy and household appliances. Visitors have the opportunity to discover a wide array of items, including fragrances, jewelry, clothing, bicycles, leather goods, underwear, sportswear, sunglasses, as well as various beverages and confections. The fair plays a significant role for both Paris and France as a whole. It reinforces the national awareness of quality, craftsmanship, and innovation and encourages the purchase of domestically-produced goods. A special highlight of the event is the awarding of the "Made in France Grands Prix", which honors outstanding French products and services. The program is complemented by engaging conferences featuring experts discussing topics such as the reparability of items and the importance of craftsmanship. A notable attraction is the "Usine Éphémère", where visitors can closely witness the manufacturing process of everyday objects. Additionally, the fair is enhanced by various entertainment activities, like blind tastings, product presentations, games, and more. The primary audience of the MIF Expo consists of professionals from the fashion, gastronomy, and household sectors. However, end consumers, who have a penchant for the French lifestyle and quality products, are also present in large numbers. Finally, the venue, the Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, stands out as one of the largest exhibition centers in Europe. It is easily accessible by both public transportation and car. Paris, the vibrant heart of France, enriches the fair visit with its rich culture, history, and attractions, making the event an unforgettable experience.

Since its founding in 1989, SAVIM – short for Salon des Vins et de la Gastronomie Méditerranéenne – has established itself as one of the most important fine food and gourmet fairs in southern France. Held twice a year, the event transforms the Parc Chanot exhibition center in Marseille into a culinary meeting point for food lovers, professionals, and producers. Organized by SAVIM EXPO SARL, the fair offers a distinctive setting for exchange and discovery, shaped by a strong focus on quality, authenticity, and regional diversity. SAVIM is more than a traditional consumer fair – it is an immersive journey through the culinary landscapes of France. Only carefully selected winegrowers from prestigious regions such as Bordeaux, Bourgogne, Champagne, and Provence are featured. Their offerings are complemented by premium spirits, craft beers, and refined non-alcoholic beverages. The spotlight is consistently on terroir and artisanal production, which give each product its unique character. The fine food selection is equally impressive in both variety and quality. From aged cheeses, air-dried charcuterie, and aromatic truffles to cold-pressed oils, exquisite spices, and handcrafted chocolates and confections – the fair offers a sensory experience that delights on every level. Organic and biodynamic products also play a central role: with over 100 certified exhibitors, SAVIM is recognized as the largest organic fair in southern France, demonstrating a strong commitment to sustainability. Many of the producers also carry the HVE (Haute Valeur Environnementale) environmental certification. Special tasting areas, each curated around a specific theme – such as oysters, Corsican meats, or regional cheeses – invite visitors to explore the richness of French culinary culture. This experience is further enriched by daily wine seminars led by Maîtres-Sommeliers, who share expert knowledge, practical advice, and personal stories in an intimate setting. SAVIM attracts a diverse audience. Industry professionals – including delicatessen retailers, restaurateurs, hoteliers, sommeliers, and wine critics – value the fair as a key networking event. At the same time, private visitors are given a unique opportunity to experience authentic French gastronomy in all its variety. The event also highlights Marseille’s role as a cultural hub of southern France, with direct access to some of the country’s finest regional products. A standout feature of the fair is its vibrant and inviting atmosphere. Spacious seating areas and dedicated dining zones recreate the ambiance of a traditional marketplace, encouraging guests to linger, explore, and enjoy. Thanks to its central location and excellent public transport connections, the fair is easily accessible by both car and public transit – the perfect setting to immerse oneself in the world of fine food and be inspired by the French art de vivre .

The FOOD & LIFE event in Munich is a prestigious consumer and sales fair dedicated entirely to the themes of food, drink, and enjoyment. Established in 2004, the fair has been organized by GHM Gesellschaft für Handwerksmessen mbH and, since the spring of 2023, takes place twice a year. It has established itself as Germany's largest meeting point for culinary excellence, attracting visitors interested in high-quality, artisanal delicacies. The fair offers an impressive variety of products and services. Ranging from small manufacturers with regional specialties to producers of sustainable organic products, the selection is diverse. It includes spreads, baked and confectionery goods, fine and health foods, fish, meat and sausages, beverages and spirits, spices, herbs, vinegar, oil, coffee, tea, dairy products, eggs, fruits, and vegetables. This culinary abundance makes the fair a paradise for gourmets and lovers of good taste. A distinctive feature of FOOD & LIFE is the presentation by passionate distillers, brewers, coffee roasters, chocolatiers, and butchers, who showcase their products and their production processes. Celebrity chefs demonstrate their skills on live stages, making the fair an interactive and educational experience. The venue, Messe München, provides an ideal platform for this event. With its modern infrastructure and accessibility, it is a suitable setting for showcasing the diverse culinary world.

WorldFood Istanbul is much more than a traditional food trade fair. It is regarded as a central, annual platform for the international food industry, dedicated to innovation, sustainability, and global exchange. The name "WorldFood" underscores the event's global scope: In Istanbul, producers, decision-makers, retailers, marketing experts, and technology providers from every continent come together to explore current developments, innovative products, and the latest technologies in food and beverages. The event is held at the renowned Tüyap Fair Convention & Congress Center, which offers an ideal setting for the trade fair thanks to its modern infrastructure and convenient location. The event is organized by ICA Events. Over the course of four days, WorldFood Istanbul addresses key industry topics. The opening day focuses on market potential, export opportunities, economic forecasts, and trends. The second day highlights climate protection, sustainability, and innovative production methods. This is followed by new quality standards, clean label concepts, and functional foods that promote healthy nutrition. The final day covers artificial intelligence, experience design, and the digital transformation of the sector. A special feature is the "Food Tech Garage", which brings together start-ups and established companies to jointly develop solutions for greater efficiency, sustainability, and climate protection. The trade fair not only presents foods from a wide range of segments—from raw materials to finished products for retail—but also showcases advanced technologies, packaging solutions, and services along the entire value chain. Exhibitors represent all areas of the food industry, including producers, suppliers, machine manufacturers, and distributors. The professional audience primarily consists of decision-makers, buyers, manufacturers, retailers, and marketing professionals. As a bridge between Europe and Asia, Istanbul offers ideal conditions for WorldFood Istanbul. The fair reinforces the city’s role as a global hub for the food trade and opens doors to the dynamic Turkish market as well as new international sales opportunities. The Tüyap Fair Center is easily accessible by public transportation and car, offers ample parking, and impresses with its modern facilities. Each year, WorldFood Istanbul becomes the central meeting point for everyone who wants to actively shape the future of the food industry.

The GenussGipfel is an annual trade fair dedicated to fine foods, delicacies and premium gourmet products. It is held at Hamburg Messe alongside Nordstil. As an established networking platform for Germany's fine food industry, the GenussGipfel brings together manufacturers, importers, artisan producers and brands with buyers, specialist retailers and hospitality professionals. The trade fair is organised by Messe Frankfurt GmbH, which also stages Nordstil, one of Germany's leading regional consumer goods trade fairs. The GenussGipfel complements Nordstil's "Kitchen & Enjoyment" exhibition segment with a carefully curated selection of premium fine food and gourmet products, creating valuable synergies between retail, concept stores, specialist wine merchants, the hospitality sector and the food trade. Held annually, the event has established itself as a key industry meeting place where retailers can discover new products at an early stage, expand their product ranges and build valuable business relationships. The exhibition showcases fine foods and delicacies from Germany and around the world. The product range includes antipasti, speciality cheeses and cured meats, fish products, truffles, premium spreads, preserves, honey and a wide variety of other gourmet specialities. The offering is complemented by fine wines, spirits, craft gin, grappa, sake and other premium beverages. Exhibitors also present artisan chocolates, pralines and confectionery, together with premium spices, olive oils, vinegars, barbecue products and other ingredients for high-end cuisine. International culinary showcases are a particular highlight, featuring specialities from countries including Italy, France, Portugal, Greece, the Nordic countries and Japan. Innovative artisan producers and start-ups also use the event to introduce new gourmet products, sustainable concepts and emerging food trends to a professional trade audience. The GenussGipfel plays an important role in the German-speaking fine food market by providing manufacturers and producers with direct access to decision-makers from the retail and hospitality sectors. Exhibitors include fine food producers, delicatessen manufacturers, wine and spirits producers, importers, food brands, as well as manufacturers of spices, oils and gourmet products. Trade visitors are drawn primarily from specialist fine food retailers, the grocery retail sector, specialist wine merchants, hospitality, hotels, food wholesalers, concept stores and independently owned supermarkets. Many buyers attend specifically to discover new products, establish relationships with suppliers and place orders for the forthcoming season. Among the event's highlights are exclusive tastings, product presentations by leading manufacturers and a wide range of networking events designed to encourage direct interaction between producers and buyers. The fair also presents the "Product of the Year" award, voted for by trade visitors, and the "Delicacy of the Year" award, presented by the members of Corpus Culinario e. V. Both awards generate significant media exposure for the winning products and are widely recognised within the fine food industry as marks of quality. Hamburg is one of Germany's leading centres for trade and gastronomy, and its international outlook provides the ideal setting for a trade fair with both national and international participation. The event takes place at the modern Hamburg Messe exhibition centre in the heart of the city. Its central location, excellent public transport links, multiple U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations, and convenient access from Hamburg Central Station and Hamburg Airport provide outstanding conditions for exhibitors and trade visitors from Germany and abroad.

The Winter FancyFaire is more than a traditional trade show. It serves as a vibrant meeting point for the North American specialty food scene, bringing together thought leaders, producers, retailers, and trendsetters from across the industry. Organized by the renowned Specialty Food Association, Inc. (SFA), the event takes place annually in winter, rotating between various cities across the United States. At its core, the Winter FancyFaire showcases the defining developments shaping the future of specialty foods – from sustainable product concepts and innovative preparation methods to strategic brand building. Curated selections highlight products across fine foods, beverages, functional nutrition, plant-based innovations, clean-label solutions, and other culinary trends. Innovation, taste, and craftsmanship are seamlessly interwoven throughout the exhibition. Signature formats such as the First Taste Table offer buyers focused tasting experiences, while the interactive Discovery Kitchen features top chefs from the U.S. West Coast demonstrating real-world applications of new products. Positioned as a discovery platform for industry professionals, the Winter FancyFaire offers targeted opportunities to explore emerging brands in the Debut District , engage with category-specific themes in dedicated pavilions, or experience exceptional packaging design in the curated Spotlight Shoppe . The event is tailored to a specialized audience: retail buyers, culinary professionals, distributors, foodservice experts, trend scouts, and media representatives – all looking for the next big ideas in the specialty food market. A highlight of the event is the presentation of the prestigious sofi Awards, honoring outstanding product quality and innovation. In addition to Gold Awards and the coveted Product of the Year title, the recently introduced Timeless Taste Award celebrates products with lasting appeal and flavor excellence. These accolades are considered a benchmark in the U.S. specialty food industry and provide recipients with significant market visibility. As part of the year-round FancyFaire series – which also includes a summer edition – the Winter FancyFaire has become a key fixture in the industry calendar. It is more than a showcase of products; it is a catalyst for ideas and innovation that drive the entire world of gourmet and specialty foods forward – year after year.

Expo Café & Gourmet is Mexico’s leading trade fair dedicated to coffee and premium gourmet products. It stands for quality, professionalism, and refined indulgence in an exclusive setting. Each year, the Guadalajara Exhibition Center becomes the central meeting point for coffee experts, gourmet producers, industry professionals, restaurateurs, and discerning food enthusiasts. The event is organized by Tradex Exposiciones, a seasoned organizer renowned for its successful trade fairs in the food and hospitality sectors. What sets the fair apart is its unique combination of two worlds of taste: the aromatic depth of coffee and the sophistication of selected gourmet delicacies. It serves not only as a platform for professional exchange but also as a catalyst for trends and innovations in coffee preparation, artisanal food production, and gastronomy equipment. At the heart of the exhibition are products and services from key areas of the industry – from specialized roasters and professional coffee machines to precision grinders, barista tools, and high-quality foods such as cheese, bread, cured meats, jams, wines, and spirits. Exclusive culinary publications also feature prominently. A special highlight is the strong presence of Mexican coffee culture: numerous producers from across the country offer insights into their craft and demonstrate the outstanding quality of their work – a living testament to Mexico’s rich coffee tradition. The vibrant atmosphere of the event is shaped by the diversity of its exhibitors and attendees. Represented are companies from the coffee industry, gastronomy, hospitality, food retail, machinery, and interior design. The professional audience includes café owners, restaurateurs, buyers, distributors, and sommeliers. The Guadalajara Exhibition Center is one of the most modern trade fair venues in Mexico. Conveniently located within the city, it is easily accessible by car and public transport, offers ample parking, and provides excellent infrastructure for both national and international visitors. Whether you're looking to forge new business connections, launch products, or explore the region’s finest flavors – Expo Café & Gourmet brings together everything related to coffee and gastronomy at the highest level.

Held annually at the Eurexpo Lyon exhibition centre in Chassieu, a suburb of Lyon, the event is part of a nationwide series of fairs also hosted in cities such as Paris, Strasbourg, Lille and Bordeaux. What sets the Salon apart is its refreshingly different approach: no middlemen, no flashy stage shows – just meaningful encounters with the independent winemakers who present their wines in person, share their philosophy, and bring their terroirs to life. Every stand is identically designed to ensure a level playing field for all exhibitors. Established names and rising stars stand side by side, creating an ideal environment for discovery, new taste experiences, and genuine conversations at eye level. At the heart of the event is the extraordinary diversity of the French wine landscape. Visitors can sample fine wines from regions including Alsace, Bordeaux, Burgundy, Beaujolais, Languedoc-Roussillon, Provence and Corsica, the Loire Valley, the South-West, and the Rhône Valley – all with a tasting glass handed to them upon entry. Here, wine is not just tasted – it’s experienced: sensuous, immediate, and deeply personal. The fair is complemented by a wide selection of regional delicacies – from cheeses, foie gras and oysters to traditionally crafted charcuterie. Lyon – regarded as the gateway to the wines of the Rhône Valley – provides the perfect setting, with the Eurexpo Lyon in Chassieu offering a modern, easily accessible venue. Whether arriving by car, shuttle, or public transport, guests are guaranteed a relaxed, enjoyable experience centred around discovery, flavour and connection.

World Hotel is an international trade fair for the hotel and hospitality industry, held annually at the PTAK Warsaw Expo in Nadarzyn. Since its inception in 2008, it has grown into a key platform for professionals from the hotel, gastronomy, and tourism sectors. The name "WorldHotel" symbolizes the global exchange of innovative solutions and services that drive the industry forward. Organized by the renowned Ptak Warsaw Expo Sp. z o. o., the trade fair offers a comprehensive showcase of the latest trends and technologies in the industry. The key focus areas include hotel furnishings, catering supplies, building technology, digitalization, and sustainability. Exhibitors present a diverse range of products, from hotel furniture, textiles, and decorative items to telecommunications and IT solutions for hotel management, as well as cleaning products, air conditioning systems, security solutions, and building automation. Innovations in leisure and wellness infrastructure also play a central role. WorldHotel attracts an international audience, including hotel operators, restaurateurs, interior designers, suppliers, and decision-makers in facility management. Beyond being a marketplace for innovative products, the event serves as a networking hub where industry experts exchange insights and establish valuable business connections. A highlight of the trade fair is the "Hotel Innovation Forum", which features inspiring lectures, workshops, and discussions on current trends and challenges. Industry experts provide valuable insights into future technologies, sustainable concepts, and economic developments shaping the hotel industry in the long term. Additionally, the event offers numerous networking opportunities, fostering direct interaction between businesses and professionals. As an integral part of Poland's trade fair calendar, WorldHotel strengthens the country's position as a key hub for the hotel and hospitality sector in Central and Eastern Europe. Conveniently located near Warsaw, the PTAK Warsaw Expo—the largest trade and congress center in the region—is easily accessible. Its state-of-the-art infrastructure makes the event an attractive meeting point for national and international companies working together to shape the future of the hospitality industry.

GastroPan is a trade fair for the bakery, confectionery, and catering industries. Since its founding in 2009, it has established itself as an important meeting place for professionals, entrepreneurs, and decision-makers. The name is a combination of "Gastro" for "gastronomy" and "Pan" for bread, reflecting the trade fair's focus: food production. The event takes place annually at different locations throughout Romania and is organized by Boro-Info Srl, a company specializing in trade events for the food industry. GastroPan brings together innovation and tradition, addressing current trends such as digitalization and automation to optimize production processes in bakeries and confectioneries. At the same time, it serves as a platform for artisanal craftsmanship, where outstanding professionals showcase their expertise. A particular highlight is the "Bread of the Year" competition, which shines a spotlight on both artisanal and industrial baking excellence. The fair offers a comprehensive range of products and services, including state-of-the-art technologies, equipment, raw materials, and ingredients for the production of bakery and confectionery goods, ice cream, chocolate, and donuts. The gastronomy and HoReCa sectors also benefit from tailored solutions for restaurants, bars, cafés, hotels, guesthouses, and catering businesses. The program is further enriched by IT solutions, consultancy services, and marketing strategies specifically designed for the food industry. In addition to its diverse exhibitor offerings, GastroPan is renowned for its prestigious competitions, where the finest bakery and confectionery products are awarded. These competitions provide professionals with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills and engage with industry peers. Each year, the fair attracts a wide range of bakers, confectioners, restaurateurs, hoteliers, and decision-makers seeking innovative solutions and new business opportunities.

The "Wine & More" fair at the Kesselhaus in Kolbermoor is a paradise for wine aficionados and those aspiring to be. It attracts numerous visitors from the local region and beyond, all keen on high-quality wines, spirits, and culinary delights. During this two-day event, many national and international exhibitors showcase their products and services. The event is organized by Ingo Raibold, who is dedicated to bringing together wine enthusiasts and interested attendees. Look forward to an array of delightful red, white, and rosé wines, outstanding champagnes and sparkling wines, organic products, and top-notch whiskeys and spirits. The focus is on rich red wines, but fresh and fruity white wines are also featured prominently. You're sure to find the perfect bottle for cozy evenings by the fireplace or lively garden parties. The fair represents diverse wine regions from Germany and Austria, Italy, Spain, Australia, New Zealand, France, South Africa, Bulgaria, Argentina, Chile, Canada, and Greece. During your visit, compare wines and many other treats. Conversations with the vintners and producers are prioritized, laying the foundation for personal purchase decisions at direct-from-the-producer prices. Complementing the wine, anticipate fine delicacies from various regional cuisines. Culinary delights such as South Tyrolean cheese and bacon, olive oils, pumpkin seed products, jams, and essences round off the fair. Direct contact with customers is paramount for our vintners. Only in this way can they find the perfect wine for you. While there might be larger wine fairs, here, you are unquestionably the center of attention. The Kesselhaus in Kolbermoor is within walking distance of the train station, and there's ample parking nearby. The "Wine & More" in Landshut isn't just an exhibition, but also a social event, making it an ideal platform for indulgence, information, and connecting with like-minded individuals in a relaxed atmosphere.

Kulinar Tulln is the most significant gourmet fair in Lower Austria, attracting food enthusiasts, gastronomy professionals, and lovers of fine cuisine to the picturesque town of Tulln on the Danube each year. As a public fair, it welcomes everyone passionate about high-end cuisine, innovative food trends, and exclusive wines. Organized by Messe Tulln GmbH, the event is held at a modern exhibition center, offering excellent accessibility and ideal infrastructure for a delightful culinary experience. The focus of Kulinar Tulln is the diverse world of gastronomy, food, and kitchen culture. Visitors can explore regional specialties, international delicacies, fine wines and spirits, organic products, as well as innovative kitchen tools and cooking appliances. The fair is not only a unique opportunity to discover new flavors but also provides exciting insights into the latest trends in the food and gourmet industry. A special highlight is the Cooking Arena, where renowned top chefs and award-winning "Hauben" chefs showcase their culinary skills live, creating exclusive dishes. Hauben chefs are outstanding culinary masters recognized by the prestigious Austrian restaurant guide Gault&Millau, which awards them one or more Hauben (French: toque, chef’s hat). These chefs set new gastronomic standards with their innovative creations and commitment to the highest product quality. Visitors have the opportunity to learn directly from the professionals, try out new recipes, and draw inspiration from their expertise. Another highlight is the wide range of wine tastings, where guests can sample exquisite regional wines as well as international top selections. Running alongside Kulinar Tulln is "pool + garden Tulln", an exhibition dedicated to stylish outdoor living. The combination of a gourmet fair and a garden expo creates a unique experience for those who appreciate both culinary delights and exclusive outdoor living. With its diverse offerings, top-tier program, and exceptional atmosphere, Kulinar Tulln is an unmissable event for anyone who enjoys the art of fine dining with passion.

The "TISCH & TAFEL" fair in Fellbach, not far from Stuttgart, takes place every April and is organized by M&S Messebau & Service GmbH. It has established itself as a significant meeting point for enthusiasts of culinary and living culture. The fair combines gastronomy, drink culture, living, and interior design into an extraordinary experience. Exhibitors present a carefully selected range of products of the highest quality, convincing not only with their characteristics but also with their unique backgrounds. The selection ranges from handmade kitchen and decorative items to extensive living furniture, inviting visitors to immerse themselves in the world of sophisticated living. At the culinary stands, a variety of delicacies tempts attendees, from spirits and spreads to wines and gourmet foods. Additionally, the fair's program includes exclusive cooking shows by renowned chefs and a variety of tastings to satisfy every taste. A characteristic element of "TISCH & TAFEL" is its venue, the Alte Kelter in Fellbach. This historic site, located in the heart of Fellbach and close to the state capital Stuttgart, gives the fair a special atmosphere. The Alte Kelter impresses not only with its imposing architecture and history but also with its excellent public transport connections. For drivers, ample parking is available near the Max-Graser-Stadium. Hosted by M&S Messebau & Service GmbH, "TISCH & TAFEL" reflects the organizers' passion and commitment to creating a platform where exquisite products from the realms of culinary and living culture are showcased. The fair serves as an interface between tradition and innovation, promoting exchange between local producers and an interested audience. As an annual highlight in April, it attracts visitors interested in current trends and innovations in the quality of life and living.

It is organised by Montgomery International Ltd., an experienced British exhibition organiser with a strong international outlook and extensive industry connections. IFE spans the full breadth of the food and drink sector, structured into clearly defined product areas. These include vegan and plant-based products, speciality and artisan foods, chilled and frozen lines, ambient grocery, and wholesale ranges. Health-focused, organic and naturally positioned products also feature prominently. International pavilions showcase culinary concepts from around the globe, creating tangible import and distribution opportunities within the UK market. The show is further enhanced by a dedicated start-up area for emerging brands, a specialist cheese pavilion for premium dairy products, a “free-from” zone for allergen-free and specialist formulations, and a business support hub offering guidance on growth strategies and market entry. In addition, technological innovation, packaging solutions and specialist services for manufacturing, logistics and retail form an integral part of the exhibition. Exhibitors represent virtually every segment of the food and drink industry: producers of ready meals, meat and seafood, bakery products, snacks, confectionery and spices, alongside drinks manufacturers ranging from spirits and soft drinks to low- and no-alcohol propositions. Buyers from major retail chains, wholesalers, distributors and importers, as well as foodservice operators, hospitality professionals, product developers and category managers, attend to source products, monitor market developments and build strategic partnerships. As such, IFE provides not only a commercially relevant marketplace but also a logistically convenient platform for companies looking to succeed in the global food and drink sector.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Speciality & Fine Food Fair (SFFF) is one of the leading trade fairs for premium food and drink specialties in the United Kingdom. Held annually in September at the prestigious ExCeL London in the heart of London, the event is organised by Montgomery International Ltd., a globally active and experienced trade show organiser. The fair is considered a must-attend event for professionals in the fine food trade, gastronomy, and high-end retail sectors. The fair serves as a platform for discovering and tasting innovative products from both the UK and abroad. It fosters meaningful dialogue among producers, buyers, retailers, importers, exporters, and hospitality professionals. The focus lies firmly on quality, authenticity, and taste – from award-winning cheeses and craft spirits to internationally recognised delicatessen products. With a clear emphasis on the evolving needs of a dynamic industry—where provenance, craftsmanship and sustainability play an increasingly vital role—the Speciality & Fine Food Fair provides targeted inspiration. Signature features such as “Pitch Live”, where emerging brands present their products to leading retailers, and the “Start-Up Village”, which showcases innovative newcomers, help bring the latest trends to light. A particular highlight is the curated education programme on the “Food for Thought” stage. Industry experts offer valuable insights into current developments, including trend forecasting, artificial intelligence in retail, ethical sustainability, gender diversity in the drinks sector, and cyber resilience. This knowledge-sharing format adds significant value beyond the product showcases. The newly designed Village Square serves as the central networking hub, offering space for regional tastings, moderated discussions, and business matchmaking. The fair experience is further enriched by immersive zones such as the Drinks Quarter, Wine Cellar and Great Taste Deli, where visitors can explore the latest flavour and consumer trends. Firmly rooted in London and the UK, the Speciality & Fine Food Fair highlights regional British specialties while simultaneously positioning the country as an international hub for fine food innovation. The historic ExCeL London, with its central location and excellent public transport links, offers ideal conditions for national and international trade visitors. For those seeking new impulses, a strong focus on quality, and opportunities to connect with thought leaders across the sector, the Speciality & Fine Food Fair remains an essential event on the industry calendar.

전시회명: World Travel Catering & Onboard Services Expo
축제소개: The World Travel Catering & Onboard Services Expo (WTCE) is the leading trade fair for onboard catering, onboard services, and passenger comfort. Since its inception in 2012, it has established itself as a key platform for innovation and industry trends. Organized annually by RX UK Reed Exhibitions Ltd., the event traditionally takes place at the Hamburg Messe, a centrally located venue with excellent infrastructure. As a major industry meeting point, WTCE brings together experts, suppliers, and decision-makers to showcase the latest products and services for the aviation, rail, and cruise industries. WTCE offers in-depth insights into the world of inflight catering, onboard retail, and passenger services. Visitors gain exclusive access to innovative solutions ranging from high-quality food and beverages to eco-friendly packaging, digital service offerings, and comfort products such as blankets, pillows, and duty-free items. Companies present products and technologies designed to enhance and streamline the travel experience, including sustainable catering solutions and state-of-the-art inflight entertainment systems. A key highlight of WTCE is the Taste of Travel Theatre, where international top chefs, industry analysts, and experts discuss the latest trends and concepts. Here, groundbreaking ideas for onboard catering and passenger comfort are introduced, shaping the future of the travel industry. Running alongside the exhibition is the prestigious Passenger Experience Conference (PEC), which provides in-depth insights into the future of passenger care and develops strategies for optimizing onboard environments. WTCE attracts exhibitors and trade visitors from a variety of sectors, including airlines, rail operators, cruise lines, catering providers, logistics companies, and onboard equipment manufacturers. It serves as a platform for networking, business deals, and the exchange of innovative ideas. In addition to leading companies, startups are also represented, bringing fresh momentum to the industry with their pioneering concepts. As one of Europe's most important aviation hubs and home to numerous aerospace suppliers, Hamburg provides the perfect setting for the event with its well-connected exhibition center. The city is not only known for its innovative strength but also for its cultural diversity and maritime atmosphere, which further enrich the visitor experience. The World Travel Catering & Onboard Services Expo (WTCE) is much more than just a trade fair – it is a driving force for the future of onboard services, an innovation hub, and a unique networking platform for the entire industry. Anyone looking to succeed in the world of travel catering and onboard services cannot afford to miss WTCE.

The Wein & More trade fair in Landshut is a small but fine, family wine fair in Lower Bavaria that focuses on the world of wines, spirits and culinary delights. The trade fair takes place in the Stadtsäle Bernlochner in Landshut, a modern and versatile event hall in the Bavarian city. It attracts numerous visitors from the region and beyond who are interested in high-quality wines, spirits and culinary delights. During the two-day event, numerous national and international exhibitors will present their products and services. It is organized by organizer Ingo Raibold, who is committed to bringing wine lovers and interested visitors together. Wein & More offers a wide range of wines, spirits, cheese, chocolate, delicatessen and other specialties from different regions and countries. The trade fair is a meeting point for winemakers, dealers, restaurateurs, sommeliers, trade visitors and wine lovers who want to exchange ideas about the latest trends, developments and innovations in the world of wine and gourmet enjoyment. In addition to the exhibition area, Wein & More offers a diverse supporting program ranging from tastings, seminars, workshops and specialist lectures to culinary shows and presentations. Experts and industry insiders share their knowledge and experiences with visitors and offer valuable information, tips and suggestions for selecting, storing and tasting wines and other products. The Wein & More in Landshut is not just a trade fair, but also a social event and therefore an ideal platform for enjoyment, information and exchange with like-minded people in a relaxed atmosphere.

The "Market of Good Taste" (Markt des guten Geschmacks) in Stuttgart, a standout fair of the Slow Food movement, takes place annually in the spring. It is dedicated to showcasing and promoting regional specialties that are free from additives. Since its inception, the fair has evolved into a significant meeting point for gourmets and consumers who value quality, taste, and sustainable production. Organized by Messe Stuttgart GmbH, the fair presents an impressive selection of food and beverages from regional producers, with a focus on the quality and taste experience of the products. The event serves not only as a platform for exchange between visitors and exhibitors but also as a place for education and active participation. Visitors have the opportunity to engage directly with the producers, sample their products, and become actively involved in the fair's own cooking workshop. Under guidance, they can prepare their own dishes and then enjoy them in a convivial round. In addition to food and beverages, the fair's offerings also include handmade kitchen furniture and utensils, as well as specialist books on topics related to food and drink. An extensive program of discussion forums and lectures provides deeper insights into the Slow Food movement and sustainable food production. The fair is held at the easily accessible Stuttgart Exhibition Center, located near the A8 motorway. Thanks to its proximity to Stuttgart Airport and the numerous parking options available both at the exhibition grounds and in the airport parking garage, arrival by car and on foot is convenient. The connection to public transport also ensures a hassle-free arrival for visitors from different regions. With its spring timing, the "Market of Good Taste" has established itself as an important event that embodies the values of the Slow Food movement and provides a platform for exchange and discovery of regional, sustainable food and products.

The BBQ Days are the leading trade and consumer fair for everyone who sees barbecuing not just as a method of cooking, but as a true passion. Every year, Messe Stuttgart in the heart of Baden-Württemberg transforms into a vibrant hub for barbecue lovers, outdoor enthusiasts, culinary connoisseurs, and professionals from the meat and grilling industry. Organized by Landesmesse Stuttgart GmbH, the BBQ Days ignite the season – traditionally held in summer – bringing real heat to the grill and energy to the exhibition halls. The focus lies on barbecuing, outdoor cooking, and premium culinary experiences. The event combines live shows, competitions, expert advice, and product innovations into an immersive experience that appeals equally to consumers and professionals from gastronomy, meat processing, retail, and event catering. A major highlight is the extensive display of modern grilling technology and outdoor kitchens – ranging from classic smokers to ceramic and pellet grills, all the way to high-tech gas grills with infrared searing features. The offering is rounded off with accessories, premium ingredients, spices, and technical equipment – everything ambitious grillers and seasoned professionals need for the ultimate barbecue. A signature element of the BBQ Days is the daily live grilling shows featuring renowned grill masters. Visitors enjoy exclusive insights, expert tips, and the chance to sample freshly prepared creations. High-caliber competitions add further excitement, including the BBQ Republic Invitational, where top barbecue teams face off in a live cook-off, and the Butcher Wars Germany – the contest to crown the country’s best butcher. These events highlight the professional caliber of the fair and provide emotional highlights throughout the program. Exhibitors come from a wide range of sectors: manufacturers of grills and outdoor kitchens, suppliers of accessories, fine food producers, butcheries, specialists in meat processing tools, and innovative start-ups from the gourmet and tech industries all use the BBQ Days as a platform to showcase new products and make valuable connections. While the fair attracts barbecue fans of all kinds, its core audience also includes professionals from food retail, gastronomy, the meat industry, and the event and catering sectors. With its unique blend of entertainment, commerce, and expertise, the BBQ Days are among the most important barbecue events in the German-speaking world. Messe Stuttgart impresses with state-of-the-art infrastructure and a prime location – directly connected to the airport and easily accessible by motorway and public transport. Attending the BBQ Days means experiencing a first-class BBQ event while discovering the culinary diversity of the Baden-Württemberg gourmet region.

InterFood Krasnodar is a specialized annual trade fair dedicated to food, beverages, and packaging technology. It has established itself as a key industry platform in southern Russia. Organized by MVK – International Exhibition Company, one of the country's leading trade fair organizers with extensive experience in hosting international exhibitions and conferences, InterFood provides industry professionals with an opportunity to explore the latest developments in the food and beverage sectors and connect with experts, manufacturers, suppliers, and decision-makers. The event takes place at Expograd Yug in Krasnodar, a modern exhibition and congress center known for its innovative infrastructure. The venue offers ideal conditions for showcasing new products, technologies, and services, making it one of the most important locations for trade events in southern Russia—further underscoring the fair’s significance. Access to InterFood is restricted to trade professionals only. This focused approach encourages practical, in-depth exchanges between exhibitors and buyers. A standout feature is the integrated negotiation center, where manufacturers and suppliers present their products directly to senior buyers and category managers from major retail chains and distributors—a unique format that enables efficient, high-level networking. The exhibition covers a broad yet clearly defined range of topics, including meat and poultry products, dairy and cheese, staple foods, grain-based goods, baked and confectionery items, non-alcoholic and low-alcohol beverages, beer, snacks, and catering supplies. This is complemented by displays of cutting-edge production and processing technologies, innovative packaging solutions, and efficient storage and logistics systems—particularly attractive to technology-focused professionals. Another highlight of the fair is its hands-on program of expert lectures and seminars on current topics such as the use of artificial intelligence in food production, brand strategies in consumer goods, lab data analysis, and risk management in manufacturing. Running alongside InterFood is the "Vinorus.Vinotech" exhibition, where Russian wineries showcase their products through professional tastings—adding further value for visitors with an interest in wine and spirits. With its thematic depth, clear focus, and recurring annual format, InterFood Krasnodar is an essential platform for professionals looking to stay ahead of industry trends, discover innovative products, and build valuable business connections—at one of Russia’s most dynamic hubs for the food and beverage industry.

SIAL Canada is one of Canada’s leading trade shows for the food, beverage, and hospitality sectors, serving as a central meeting point for professionals across this dynamic industry. The name SIAL – Salon International de l’Alimentation – highlights the event’s international focus and its specialization in food-related innovation. Since its inception in 2001, the trade show has become a major driver of innovation, commerce, and exchange within the North American agri-food sector. Held alternately in Montreal and Toronto each year, SIAL Canada brings together all key players under one roof. It is organized by the renowned Comexposium Group, one of the world’s largest trade show organizers with an extensive portfolio of international events. The Canadian edition is part of a global network that includes flagship shows in Paris, Jakarta, and Abu Dhabi. A defining feature of SIAL Canada is its clear thematic structure, divided into three focus areas: SIAL Food, SIAL Grocerant, and SIAL Packaging. SIAL Food covers the entire food production spectrum – from fresh products and beverages to niche categories such as baby food, frozen goods, and functional ingredients. SIAL Grocerant explores the growing intersection between foodservice and retail, emphasizing cutting-edge kitchen equipment, payment technologies, and service solutions. SIAL Packaging focuses on innovative and sustainable packaging concepts, logistics, and technological advancements across the supply chain. In addition to a broad product offering – ranging from cheese and olive oil to high-tech packaging – the trade show provides space for knowledge exchange, industry dialogue, and inspiration. It serves as a platform for Canadian producers, international brands, start-ups, retailers, foodservice professionals, and importers to identify trends, build business relationships, and strengthen their market presence. Deeply rooted in the Canadian market, SIAL Canada reflects the country’s cultural diversity, spirit of innovation, and commitment to sustainability. At the same time, it offers international companies a gateway to enter the North American market. One of SIAL Canada’s standout features is its range of competitions that spotlight the industry’s innovative spirit. The SIAL Innovation Award honors forward-thinking product ideas, the Olive d'Or recognizes the world’s finest olive oils, and the International Cheese Competition showcases the best in global cheesemaking. Additional highlights include a pitch contest for start-ups and the “SIAL To Go” format, which offers practical insights into current market developments. The event attracts a wide professional audience – from manufacturers and distributors to institutional foodservice experts – creating a highly specialized network designed for business success. Alongside the extensive exhibition, a conference program provides in-depth analysis and discussion of key industry topics. Whether at the Palais des Congrès de Montréal or the Enercare Centre in Toronto, both venues offer modern infrastructure, excellent accessibility, and are situated in vibrant urban environments. With international airports, convenient public transit links, and thriving culinary scenes, they provide the ideal setting for a trade fair that is more than just an exhibition: SIAL Canada is an experience, a marketplace of ideas, and a bridge between local markets and global opportunities.
