The CIBUS International Food Exhibition is an annual trade fair dedicated to the diverse world of food. It is held at the Fiere di Parma exhibition center in Parma, a prominent center of Italian food culture. The name CIBUS, derived from the Latin word for "food", emphasizes the fair's central importance to the food sector. The organizer of the fair is Fiera di Parma S.p.A. It provides a platform for professionals from various sectors including wholesale, Ho.Re.Ca. sector, importers, and independent retail. The fair promotes exchange between national and international representatives from the agricultural and food sectors. The exhibition areas include dairy products, cold cuts, food and confectionery, chilled and frozen products, beverages, and specialties from local, regional, and international cuisine. CIBUS showcases a wide range of products and services, including coffee, tea, cocoa, canned goods, fresh and dried fruits and vegetables, snacks, oils, vinegars, pasta, rice, ethnic products, cereals, ready meals, baked goods, frozen products, sauces, reflecting Italy's culinary diversity and innovation. Highlights of CIBUS include conferences, expert panel discussions, workshops, tastings, live cooking shows, and masterclasses with renowned chefs. Special focus is given to the "CIBUS Innovation Zone" and "CIBUS Healthy", addressing new trends and healthy eating. Exhibitors come from various sectors of the food industry, making CIBUS a global meeting point for professionals. Main visitors are professionals from the food retail, gastronomy, catering, as well as import and export, complemented by representatives of food producers. As an annual event specifically held in Parma, CIBUS reflects the gastronomic tradition and significance of the city in the Italian food industry. Thanks to its accessibility by both public transport and car, the fair offers a unique opportunity to discover the latest trends and products in the food sector, establish business contacts, and enjoy the extraordinary atmosphere and culture of Parma.

개최장소(베뉴): Shanghai New International Expo Center - SNIEC
축제소개: Since its inception in 2000, SIAL China has been a leading international trade fair for food and beverages, held annually at the Shanghai New International Expo Center (SNIEC). The name SIAL stands for "Salon International De L'Alimentation", which translates to "International Food Exhibition." The fair is organized by Comexposium, a global operator of trade shows and conferences. The main themes of SIAL China cover a wide spectrum of the food and beverage industry, including baby food, organic and wellness products, dairy products, non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, meat, poultry, sausages, seafood, legumes, and grains. This diversity reflects the fair's central role as a platform for innovation and trends in the food industry. At SIAL China, food manufacturers, traders, importers, wholesalers, and retailers, as well as representatives of institutional and commercial gastronomy, present and discover the latest products and services. This makes the fair an important gateway to the Chinese market and a significant platform for international companies looking to engage in this dynamic environment. The fair is distinguished by its numerous competitions and award ceremonies, which honor outstanding innovations in the food and beverage industry. Highlights include the SIAL Innovation Competition, the SIAL Chic and Tea Contest, and the SIAL Cup Barista Challenge. These events promote quality and innovation and serve as a platform for the exchange between professionals and companies. SIAL China is part of a global series of SIAL fairs held in various international cities and plays a key role in the global food industry. Exhibitors and visitors come from various sectors, including food production, gastronomy, and trade. The Shanghai New International Expo Center, the venue for SIAL China, is centrally located and easily accessible. It offers modern facilities and excellent infrastructure, making it ideal for events of this magnitude and significance. The easy accessibility of the SNIEC further contributes to the fair's attractiveness, both for local and international participants.

InterFood Azerbaijan is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a key platform for the food and beverage industry in the South Caucasus. Serving as an industry meeting point, innovation forum, and international marketplace, it brings together manufacturers, distributors, technology providers, and decision-makers to showcase the latest trends, products, and solutions in the sector. The name “InterFood” symbolizes the international scope of the event and its comprehensive coverage of the entire value chain—from raw material sourcing and advanced processing technologies to packaging and marketing. The venue for the event is the modern Baku Expo Exhibition and Convention Center, located in the Azerbaijani capital of Baku. The exhibition center is distinguished by its high-quality infrastructure, convenient transport connections, and proximity to Heydar Aliyev International Airport. The trade fair is organized by Caspian Event Organisers LLC, a leading company in the region specializing in trade fairs and business events. This ensures the event is executed professionally and at a high standard. The exhibition covers a wide range of topics and is structured into four main focus areas: traditional food products such as meat and dairy, confectionery and gourmet foods, non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, technologies for processing and packaging, and Halal-certified products. As such, InterFood Azerbaijan provides a comprehensive overview of current developments—from traditional craftsmanship to cutting-edge innovations. A particular highlight of the fair is the annual “Gızıl Şah” National Culinary Championship , an international cooking competition featuring over 200 participants from around the globe. Entries are judged by a distinguished panel of experts. The event is further enriched by targeted B2B meetings, practical workshops, and professional seminars where industry specialists discuss technological advancements, market trends, and sector-specific challenges. Exhibitors represent a wide range of sectors—from agricultural production and food processing to packaging and logistics services. The professional audience primarily consists of representatives from wholesale and retail, the hospitality sector, import and export businesses, distribution, and governmental institutions. This makes the fair an efficient hub for both national and international business development. The Baku Expo Center is located in the Hovsan district, approximately 20 kilometers from the international airport, and is easily accessible via metro, bus, or taxi. In this way, InterFood Azerbaijan offers not only valuable content but also ideal logistical conditions for international business development and industry-specific networking in the heart of the South Caucasus.

개최장소(베뉴): MCEC - Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: The Good Food & Wine Show is one of Australia’s most prominent public exhibitions dedicated to culinary excellence. Since its inception in 2001, it has served as a key platform for indulgence, innovation, and exchange within the Australian food and beverage industry. Today, the name represents far more than just fine food and wine—it embodies a comprehensive experience centered around premium gastronomy, exclusive tastings, and the latest gourmet trends. Each year, the show opens its doors at the Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre (MCEC)—Australia’s largest and most modern event venue, located on the banks of the Yarra River in the heart of Melbourne. The event is organized by Spectapular Enterprises Pty Ltd, an experienced event management company specializing in the creation of impactful, brand-defining experiences. At the heart of the exhibition is the theme of indulgence, with a focus on food, wine, spirits, hospitality, kitchen technology, and culinary tourism. Visitors can look forward to a diverse program that includes live cooking demonstrations by renowned Australian chefs such as Alastair McLeod, themed masterclasses on chocolate, cheese, or gin, and over 300 carefully curated exhibitors. The show features everything from artisanal delicacies to cutting-edge kitchen solutions. Particularly popular are experiences such as the guided Wine Selectors Tasting Rooms , chocolate journeys led by pastry chef Kirsten Tibballs, and exclusive martini workshops with tailored food pairings. A standout highlight is the Good Food Village —a bustling market hall featuring select producers and artisanal makers—as well as the Cheese Corner , which showcases the diversity and creativity of Australian cheesemaking. The event appeals to a wide audience: from hobby chefs and gourmet enthusiasts to industry professionals in hospitality, retail, and tourism. At the same time, it serves as a stage for Australia’s culinary identity, illustrating how vibrantly the industry has evolved as both a creative and economic driving force. The Good Food & Wine Show is not limited to Melbourne; it is part of a national event series that also includes cities like Sydney, Brisbane, and Perth. This makes it the premier traveling culinary exhibition in Australia. Visitors can expect an immersive, high-quality experience featuring VIP offerings, interactive tastings, and expert insights—all within an atmosphere that brings the joy of food and drink to life in a unique way. The MCEC impresses with its central location, excellent public transport connections, and state-of-the-art infrastructure. As a cultural and culinary capital, Melbourne provides the perfect backdrop for an event that seamlessly blends gastronomy, lifestyle, and innovation.

Seoul Food & Hotel (SFH) is South Korea’s leading trade fair for the food, beverage, and hospitality industries, and ranks among the most important events of its kind in Asia. Held annually at the Korea International Exhibition Center (KINTEX) in Goyang—a modern city with excellent transport links just north of Seoul—the exhibition attracts decision-makers, trade professionals, and exhibitors from around the world. The event is organized by Informa Markets, a globally recognized organizer of international trade fairs. More than just an exhibition, SFH serves as a central platform for innovation, knowledge exchange, and business development in one of East Asia’s most economically dynamic regions. Its unique character lies in the combination of culinary diversity with technological advancements and high-quality equipment for the foodservice, hospitality, and food production sectors. Exhibits range from meat, seafood, dairy products, frozen foods, and baked goods to beverages. This is complemented by advanced solutions for food processing and packaging, professional kitchen equipment, logistics systems, and sustainable concepts. A key advantage of SFH is its international B2B networking program, which actively facilitates business contacts and fosters strategic partnerships. The event primarily attracts international buyers, hotel and restaurant operators, distributors, importers, wholesalers, and representatives from the food industry. Exhibitors include companies from food production, mechanical engineering, packaging technology, kitchen equipment, and hotel and hospitality services. SFH also acts as a strategic platform to position South Korea as an innovative player in the global food and hospitality market. It showcases the country’s strengths in quality, technology, and design—within an international environment focused on competition, knowledge transfer, and progress. With the ultra-modern KINTEX venue, the fair offers excellent logistical access—including proximity to the subway and Incheon International Airport—and an infrastructure ideally suited for large-scale international events. The city of Goyang itself also impresses with a wide range of hotel and leisure options, making SFH a rewarding experience both professionally and culturally.

The Good Food & Wine Show is an annual consumer exhibition that has established itself as a central event for culinary enthusiasts. The event is organized by Diversified Communications Australia at the renowned International Convention Centre (ICC) in Sydney, a leading company specializing in trade fairs. It offers a unique platform to discover the latest trends and innovations in the food and wine industry. Each year, the fair attracts thousands of food connoisseurs, wine lovers, and industry experts. The Good Food & Wine Show showcases an impressive variety of products and services covering a wide range of culinary topics. This includes wines from renowned Australian wine regions such as the Barossa Valley and Margaret River, craft beers, spirits, gourmet snacks, cheese, chocolate, and a selection of kitchen utensils and appliances. Numerous exhibitors from the food, beverage, hospitality, kitchen technology, and tourism sectors present their latest offerings, offering exclusive tastings and interactive cooking demonstrations. Highlights of the event include wine and food tastings, as well as interactive masterclasses conducted by industry experts. Live cooking demonstrations by famous Australian chefs such as Curtis Stone and Maggie Beer give visitors exciting insights into preparing exclusive dishes. Additionally, participants can attend special events such as the RIEDEL Wine Glass Experience or the Chocolate Appreciation Masterclass to deepen their knowledge of the art of wine and chocolate enjoyment. The Good Food & Wine Show fosters cultural and economic ties with Australia by showcasing the country's culinary traditions and innovative spirit, while also encouraging international exchange. The events take place not only in Sydney but also in other cities like Melbourne, Brisbane, and Perth, giving the fair national significance. It is particularly noteworthy that the fair offers professionals in the gastronomy, wine production, food manufacturing, and tourism industries valuable opportunities to network, maintain business relationships, and explore new markets. The primary visitors are both professionals from the foodservice and wine industries and culinary enthusiasts interested in the latest products and trends. The ICC Sydney, a modern and environmentally sustainable exhibition center in Darling Harbour, is the ideal venue for such a significant event. It offers top-notch facilities and is easily accessible for both local and international visitors. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere and numerous recreational opportunities, it provides the perfect location for an exhibition that stimulates all the senses and delights with a wide range of culinary experiences.

FHI Food & Hotel Indonesia is one of the most prominent and internationally recognized trade fairs for the gastronomy, hospitality, and food industries in Southeast Asia. It is organized by PT Pamerindo Indonesia, a member of the Informa Markets Group—one of the world’s leading organizers of B2B events. Held biennially at the Jakarta International Expo (JIExpo)—Indonesia’s largest and most modern exhibition center—the fair benefits from a prime location with direct access to international airports, a wide range of nearby accommodations, and well-developed transport infrastructure. The choice of venue underscores Jakarta’s role as the nation’s economic and cultural hub. The exhibition comprehensively covers the entire spectrum of the foodservice and hospitality industries—from food and beverages to kitchen technology, interior design, and packaging innovation. Visitors gain insight into the latest developments and offerings, including fresh seafood, plant-based alternatives, Halal-certified products, state-of-the-art kitchen appliances, digital service systems, and innovative beverage selections such as coffee, tea, wine, spirits, and alcohol-free options. The event is geared toward professionals from the hotel and restaurant sectors, trade, consultancy, and investment. Decision-makers in procurement and operations, as well as exhibitors from food production, technology, interior design, and service industries, use the platform to establish a foothold in Indonesia’s dynamic market—an increasingly attractive destination thanks to its young population and rapidly growing tourism sector. A standout feature of the FHI is its extensive supporting program. The FHI Food Academy offers hands-on workshops, such as “Experience the Art of Vegan Cooking,” that provide valuable opportunities for professional development. Industry talks and expert panels address emerging trends, innovations, and strategic insights. The "Innovation Spotlight" format highlights advances in hospitality technology and digital transformation. Competitions like the Salon Culinaire and the World Fashion Drinks Competition foster creativity and showcase emerging talent. In addition, structured networking programs and targeted business matchings facilitate valuable commercial connections. FHI Food & Hotel Indonesia is an essential platform for professionals across the food, beverage, and hospitality sectors looking to strengthen their market presence, discover new products, and build international partnerships. The Jakarta International Expo serves as an ideal venue with its modern infrastructure, professional event management, and excellent accessibility—a space that brings together innovation and collaboration in the heart of a vibrant, emerging metropolis.

The Good Food & Wine Show (GFWS) is one of Australia’s premier public exhibitions for food, wine, and gourmet experiences. It attracts food enthusiasts, wine connoisseurs, and industry professionals alike. Since its debut in Perth in 2008, it has impressed visitors each year with a diverse range of high-quality products, engaging live experiences, and opportunities for personal interaction. The event is held at the Perth Convention & Exhibition Centre (PCEC) – a modern venue in the heart of the city, well-connected by public transport. The show is organised by Spectapular Enterprises Pty Ltd, an experienced event management company that has created a platform through the GFWS that successfully combines culinary culture, innovation, and economic momentum. The event is far more than a traditional food fair. It showcases the culinary diversity of Australia and serves as a meeting point for the national gourmet community. Exhibits include fine wines, spirits, craft beers, premium food products, and kitchen innovations – from handcrafted delicacies to modernist cuisine and specialty items from small, independent producers. Over 200 exhibitors from renowned regions such as Margaret River, the Barossa Valley, and the Clare Valley invite visitors to exclusive tastings. Interactive masterclasses, curated food pairings, and dynamic live cooking shows featuring renowned Australian chefs turn the visit into a truly immersive experience. A highlight for many is the Kleenheat Kitchen stage, where top chefs demonstrate their skills while actively involving the audience – regardless of whether they are beginners or professionals. The event also offers the chance to speak directly with producers and discover the stories behind the products – a personal element that sets the show apart. Exhibitors represent sectors including food and beverage production, hospitality, tourism, kitchen technology, and retail. The audience is equally diverse, ranging from food-loving private visitors to professionals from the restaurant, hotel, and retail industries. The Perth edition is part of a nationwide event series that also takes place in cities such as Melbourne, Brisbane, and Sydney – each tailored to the local culinary scene. The Good Food & Wine Show is more than a culinary event – it’s a cultural highlight for Perth. It boosts tourism, supports the regional economy, and places Australia’s food and wine culture at the centre of a platform celebrated both nationally and internationally. With its central location at the Perth Convention & Exhibition Centre, just a short walk from the Swan River and easily accessible by train, bus, or car, the GFWS is the perfect destination for a flavourful weekend in Western Australia. For those seeking something special, this is the place – focused, diverse, and rich in personal experiences.

The GASTRO IVENT in Bremen represents a significant event that is held biennially and has established itself as an essential meeting point for the gastronomy, hotel industry, community catering, and trade sectors. Since its founding in 2014, the trade fair has taken place in even-numbered years, parallel to fish international, the only trade fair for fish and seafood in Germany. GASTRO IVENT has developed into a central platform that bundles and presents future-oriented, eventful and stimulating impulses as well as solutions for the catering industry. The fair is organized by M3B GmbH and takes place at the Bremen Exhibition & ÖVB-Arena, known for its flexibility and outstanding infrastructure. The GASTRO IVENT specifically targets restaurant and hotel operators, catering companies, large-scale caterers, and chefs, offering them an exclusive selection of delicacies and convenience products, regional and artisanally produced raw materials, as well as innovative equipment and technical aids. Special focus is given to regional, often artisanally produced, premium food and beverages, as well as innovative convenience products. Additionally, visitors can discover cooking accessories, facilities, and technologies for the gastronomy sector, including hardware and software solutions like cash register systems, apps, and social media applications. A diverse supplementary program featuring product tastings and demonstrations, lectures on current topics, and numerous networking opportunities distinguishes the fair. It allows for a blend of relaxation and information exchange, promoting dialogue about the latest trends and developments in the industry. Another highlight is the edutainment and consultancy offerings, which not only provide visitors with knowledge and inspiration but also practical solutions and innovations for daily business operations. This mix of exhibition, interactive experiences, and professional exchange makes the GASTRO IVENT an indispensable event for professionals from the gastronomy and related fields who are searching for new products, services, and ideas to further develop their businesses and stay up-to-date. In summary, the GASTRO IVENT in Bremen is a key event for gastronomy professionals, focusing on innovation, quality, and networking opportunities and providing a platform for showcasing industry trends and future-oriented concepts. With its comprehensive range and numerous opportunities for exchange and further education, it marks an important date in the industry's calendar.

전시회명: NRW – The Best from the Region
축제소개: Founded in 2011, the "NRW – The Best from the Region" fair is an annual regional trade show held every November, proudly showcasing the culinary diversity and artisanal crafts of North Rhine-Westphalia. Hosted by Messe Essen GmbH, this event attracts countless visitors each year who are interested in regional products and local food culture. It has become a fixed event on the trade fair calendar, taking place in the modern facilities of Messe Essen, which are easily accessible and offer extensive services. "NRW – The Best from the Region" stands out for its special focus on regional products. In an atmosphere that is appealing to both consumers and professional visitors, the exhibition provides a platform for producers and craftsmen to present their goods and services. Visitors have the opportunity to discover and sample a wide range of products, from traditional foods to handmade items, all with an emphasis on quality and sustainability. A distinctive feature of the fair is its transparency regarding the manufacturing processes of the products. Exhibitors are encouraged to share information about cultivation, production, and animal husbandry, transforming the fair into an educational platform for responsible consumption. This informative aspect is enhanced by a supporting program that includes brief presentations on selected topics. Here, current and relevant industry issues are discussed, making the fair an important hub for the exchange of ideas and further education in the region. Entertainment is also provided: the fair regularly features competitions, and as a special highlight, visitors can experience cooking demonstrations by a famous Michelin-starred chef. These events are not only entertaining but also allow for an interactive engagement with regional cuisine. "NRW – The Best from the Region" takes place under the umbrella of MHH (MODE HEIM HANDWERK), enabling synergies with related industries. With its unique combination of information, education, and entertainment, this event has established itself as an indispensable occasion that celebrates regional identity while simultaneously promoting important discussions about food production and consumption.

The SIAL InterFOOD is a leading international trade fair for the food and beverage industry, held annually at the JIExpo Jakarta International Expo in Indonesia. The name "SIAL" stands for "Salon International de l'Alimentation", which translates to "International Food Salon", emphasizing the global significance of this event. It is organized by the SIAL Group in collaboration with Krista Exhibitions and is part of a global series of SIAL trade fairs. At this fair, manufacturers, traders, and professionals from the gastronomy and retail sectors gather to showcase the latest products and innovations. Key themes include food and beverages, technologies, bakery and confectionery products, and catering equipment and ingredients. Special attention is given to sectors such as wine and spirits, coffee, tea, cocoa, as well as organic and Halal-certified products. Another focus is on services and technologies for hotels, catering, restaurants, and supermarkets, which directly relate to Jakarta's dynamic hospitality scene and Indonesia's growing market infrastructure. Competitions such as cooking contests, pastry championships, and live cooking demonstrations highlight the creative and innovative atmosphere of the fair. Each year, SIAL InterFOOD attracts thousands of professional visitors from around the world, including many decision-makers from food production, retail, and gastronomy. It serves not only as a platform for business deals but also as a venue for exchanging ideas on the latest trends and developments in food technology and production. The JIExpo, as the venue, offers ideal conditions for exhibitors and visitors with its modern infrastructure and excellent accessibility via the international airport and superb transport connections. As part of the vibrant metropolis of Jakarta, the fair provides an excellent opportunity to expand networks and explore new business opportunities. Overall, SIAL InterFOOD is an indispensable event, distinguished by its thematic diversity as well as the quality and variety of the products and services presented.

개최장소(베뉴): Yashobhoomi India International Convention & Expo Centre
축제소개: SIAL India is a leading international trade fair for food and beverages, held annually at the Yashobhoomi India International Convention & Exhibition Centre (IICC) in New Delhi. The acronym SIAL stands for "Salon International De L'Alimentation", which translates to "International Food Exhibition". The fair is organized by Comexposium in collaboration with InterAds Exhibitions Pvt. Ltd. The main themes of SIAL India encompass a wide range of the food and beverage industry, including bakery, confectionery, and biscuit products, organic and wellness products, dairy, non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, meat, poultry, deli products, seafood, legumes, and cereals. Additionally, products such as spices and seasonings, frozen food, pet food, tea, and coffee, as well as processing and packaging equipment are showcased. This diversity highlights the fair's significance as a platform for innovation and trends in the food sector. At SIAL India, food manufacturers, distributors, importers, wholesalers, and retailers, as well as representatives from institutional and commercial catering, present and discover the latest products and services. Thus, the fair serves as an important gateway to the Indian market and a crucial platform for international companies looking to engage in this dynamic environment. The fair is distinguished by numerous conferences, competitions, and award ceremonies that honor outstanding innovations in the food and beverage industry. Highlights include the SIAL Innovation Competition. These events promote quality and innovation and serve as a platform for exchange among professionals and businesses. SIAL India is part of a global series of SIAL fairs that take place in various international cities, playing a key role in the global food industry. Exhibitors and visitors come from diverse sectors, including food production, gastronomy, and commerce. The Yashobhoomi India International Convention & Exhibition Centre, the venue for SIAL India, is centrally located and easily accessible. It offers modern facilities and excellent infrastructure, ideal for events of this scale and significance. The center's accessibility further enhances the fair's attractiveness to both local and international participants.

개최국: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
축제소개: The Good Food Show in Birmingham is one of the most prestigious public culinary events in the UK. Since its inception in 1991, it has captivated a growing community of food enthusiasts, amateur chefs, and connoisseurs twice a year. Organized by BBC Good Food on behalf of Immediate Live, the show has become a cornerstone of the British food scene. Each June and November, the National Exhibition Centre (NEC) in Birmingham—one of the country’s largest and most modern exhibition venues—transforms into a vibrant celebration of culinary diversity. With its excellent infrastructure and convenient transport connections, the NEC provides the ideal setting for this exceptional event. The Good Food Show offers a unique blend of food market, live entertainment, and educational experiences. Designed for the general public rather than trade visitors alone, it places a strong focus on high-quality foods, innovative kitchen solutions, and contemporary nutrition trends. Visitors can explore a wide array of offerings: handpicked regional products, street food stalls, artisanal delicacies, organic goods, and a curated selection of wines, craft beers, and spirits—complemented by expert tastings and recommendations. A standout attraction is the live cooking shows featuring internationally renowned celebrity chefs. These chefs not only showcase their favorite recipes but also share insights into modern culinary techniques and their personal inspirations. The program is further enriched by interactive workshops and cooking classes, offering practical guidance on topics such as healthy eating, special diets, and baking arts—from gluten-free meals to plant-based cuisine. At the heart of the event lies the intersection of enjoyment and knowledge. Expert talks on sustainable nutrition, conversations with innovative producers, and direct exchanges with top chefs create a comprehensive and inspiring experience. Sustainability runs as a central theme throughout the entire event, with a clear emphasis on regionality, quality, and conscious consumption. The Good Food Show is more than just a fair—it’s a dynamic gathering place for anyone who values good food, creative cooking, and responsible eating. Whether you're interested in the latest culinary trends or seeking extraordinary taste experiences, this event offers inspiration, connection, and gourmet enjoyment at the highest level.

The Kloster & Garden Market is an annual experiential fair that transforms the historic grounds of Kloster Buch in Leisnig into a vibrant hub of garden culture, lifestyle, and rural inspiration. Set against the picturesque backdrop of the former Cistercian monastery, a unique marketplace unfolds every May for all who appreciate the beautiful, natural, and handmade – from hobby gardeners and design enthusiasts to families and professional visitors from the region and beyond. The event is organized by Arcos GmbH, an experienced company specializing in high-quality themed markets in the garden and lifestyle sectors. At the heart of the fair are selected products and creative solutions for the home, yard, garden, and contemporary living. Visitors can look forward to an inspiring range – from a rich variety of plants, with a special focus on roses, perennials, and seasonal rarities, to unique decorative items, artistic ceramics, furniture made from natural materials, terracotta and corten steel one-of-a-kinds, stylish fashion, handcrafted jewelry, and tasteful accessories for house and garden. Innovative technologies for garden maintenance and terrace design are also showcased. But the Kloster & Garden Market offers more than just a diverse shopping experience – it creates a welcoming atmosphere for relaxation and enjoyment. Within the historic monastery walls, guests can explore a culinary selection ranging from regional specialties to unique gourmet delights. The experience is further enriched by artisan demonstrations, live musical performances as part of the supporting program, and guided tours through the monastery grounds. Exhibitors primarily represent the fields of horticulture, floristry, arts and crafts, interior and exterior decoration, fashion, and fine food. The audience is just as diverse – ranging from private garden lovers and families to professionals such as landscape gardeners, planners, and florists, as well as those with a keen interest in regional culture. Located just south of Leipzig, Kloster Buch is not only an architectural gem steeped in history but also conveniently accessible – by car via the A14 (exit Leisnig) or by public transport via Leisnig railway station, with a shuttle service available to the monastery grounds. The Kloster & Garden Market at Kloster Buch is more than a fair – it is a sensory experience for everyone in search of authenticity, beauty, and something truly special.

개최장소(베뉴): CTICC Cape Town International Convention Center
축제소개: The "Plant Powered Show", a pioneering trade fair, was first held in 2020 and has since evolved into the leading African platform for plant-based nutrition, beverages, and a conscious lifestyle. It takes place at the impressive Cape Town International Convention Center (CTICC) in Cape Town, a location that is easily accessible to both local and international visitors. The fair annually attracts visitors and professionals from around the world who are interested in the latest trends and products in the plant-based lifestyle sector. Live Events Africa (Pty) Ltd., a company known for its expertise in organizing high-caliber events, is responsible for organizing the fair. The "Plant Powered Show" focuses on topics such as plant-based nutrition, sustainability, and healthy living. Exhibitors present a wide range of products and services, from innovative food and beverages to wellness and lifestyle items. The fair provides a platform where companies can showcase their latest innovations to a broad audience. The fair also contributes to strengthening local culture and economy by bringing together local and international companies, thus promoting the growth of the plant-based industry in South Africa. A special highlight is the tasting area, where renowned chefs showcase their culinary creations. This gives visitors the opportunity to discover new flavors and familiarize themselves with simple methods for healthy, sustainable dishes. The "Plant Powered Show" attracts exhibitors from various industries, including the food industry, health and wellness sector, and sustainability sector. The main visitors include professionals from these areas as well as consumers interested in a healthy and sustainable lifestyle. The CTICC is strategically located in the heart of Cape Town's business district, close to many tourist attractions, including the famous V&A Waterfront and Table Mountain. This location makes the center attractive to both business travelers and tourists who want to participate in the numerous events and exhibitions held there. The center is known for integrating sustainable practices such as water conservation measures and energy efficiency. It also engages in social projects and initiatives to strengthen the local community. In summary, the "Plant Powered Show" is more than just a fair; it is an annual gathering for all those committed to a healthy, sustainable, and conscious lifestyle. It offers a unique opportunity to network, learn, and discover the latest innovations in the plant-based industry.

Langres Gastronomique is an annual highlight for food lovers, producers, and enthusiasts of regional culinary culture. Held at the Salle Jean-Favre in Langres—a historic town in northeastern France—the event is organized by the dedicated Association Langres Foires et Salons , which is committed to promoting the region’s economy, culture, and way of life. This fair is much more than a marketplace – it serves as a vibrant showcase of the terroir , the culinary and artisanal identity of the Langres region. Numerous passionate exhibitors present their specialties, ranging from artisan cheeses and air-dried sausages to homemade pasta, honey, syrups, and premium ice cream. Visitors are not only invited to sample the products but also to engage directly with the producers – an experience that defines the unique character of the event. What further sets Langres Gastronomique apart is its successful blend of gastronomy, culture, and entertainment. The program includes cooking demonstrations, culinary competitions, and live tastings, along with musical performances, evening events, and interactive experiences for both children and adults. Workshops, talks, and hands-on activities add extra depth, turning a visit into a well-rounded and memorable experience. The fair is deliberately focused on quality over quantity, emphasizing regional food craftsmanship and artisanal products. Most exhibitors come from the fine food, specialty food production, and artisan sectors. The primary audience includes culinary professionals, hoteliers, retailers, and food enthusiasts seeking authentic products, new business contacts, or fresh culinary inspiration. Langres Gastronomique reflects the history, craftsmanship, and zest for life of the region. It plays a key role in promoting local products and producers while strengthening regional identity and pride. The centrally located Salle Jean-Favre is easily accessible by car and public transport. For anyone wishing to experience the authentic spirit of French culinary culture combined with regional diversity and a rich cultural program, Langres Gastronomique is a must-attend event on the culinary calendar.

The Gourmet Selection is an annual trade fair that has established itself as a key event in the international fine food industry since its inception in 2009. It is organized by Comexposium, one of the world’s leading trade show organizers. This exclusive event has become a highly specialized platform for delicacies, gourmet products, and culinary innovations. Held at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles—one of Europe’s largest and most modern exhibition centers—it benefits from a central location in the French capital, a city synonymous with gastronomy, lifestyle, and refined enjoyment. Excellent access to public transport ensures convenient travel for trade visitors from both France and abroad. At the heart of the fair are quality, craftsmanship, and origin. A carefully curated selection of specialties from France and around the world is showcased—ranging from characterful cheeses, premium charcuterie, foie gras, preserves, artisanal chocolates and pralines, fine pastries, and specialty breads to exquisite wines, craft spirits, and innovative non-alcoholic beverages. The event celebrates not only culinary excellence and artisanal quality but also reflects current trends such as plant-based nutrition, “free-from” products, sustainable snacking, and features on guest regions from across the globe. A distinctive feature of the fair is the strong presence of products with protected designations of origin, such as AOP, AOC, or IGP, alongside a wide range of certified organic goods carrying the AB label. Sustainability and transparent sourcing are integral to the concept of the fair and are reflected throughout the product offerings and presentations. In addition to food, the event also includes offerings related to gastronomy and fine food retail, including stylish tableware, premium packaging solutions, and digital tools for the point of sale. The fair is exclusively open to professional visitors—particularly those from the fine food trade, premium grocery retail, concept stores, as well as upscale restaurants and the hospitality sector. A highlight of the event is the “Gourmet Selection Best Of” competition, which honors outstanding and particularly innovative products—a recognized mark of quality and creativity. The fair experience is further enhanced by the Tasting Forum, where fine foods are prepared and sampled live, and the Experts’ Agora, a space dedicated to professional exchange and knowledge transfer. With its clear focus, exceptional product selection, international reach, and the unique atmosphere in the heart of Paris, Gourmet Selection offers a specialized platform for those seeking to combine excellence, innovation, and high-end indulgence.

The Summer Fancy Food Show is North America’s largest trade fair for specialty foods and is regarded as a showcase for innovation, quality, and artisanal craftsmanship in the world of culinary products. Since its inception in 1955, it has evolved into a key meeting point for the international food industry. The term “Fancy Food” not only signifies unique and premium products but also stands for high standards in taste, originality, and product quality – from exquisite delicacies to cutting-edge nutrition concepts. Every summer, the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in the heart of Manhattan opens its doors to trade visitors from around the globe. This modern, well-equipped venue impresses with its central location, close to iconic landmarks such as Times Square and Central Park. Excellent access to public transportation makes the Javits Center easily reachable – a clear advantage for international attendees. The event is organized by the Specialty Food Association (SFA) , a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting independent food producers and recognizing outstanding products. But the Summer Fancy Food Show is much more than just a product exhibition: it serves as a trendsetter, idea generator, and dynamic business platform. The event concept successfully combines culinary experience, business relevance, and thematic diversity. Across more than 40 product categories – ranging from plant-based foods and gourmet snacks to innovative beverages – visitors gain practical insights into the latest industry developments through tastings, live cooking demonstrations, and curated theme pavilions. Among the highlights are startups and product debuts, as well as dedicated sections such as the Bakery, Confectionery, Snacks & Sweets Pavilion , the Beverage Pavilion , and the Plant-Based Pavilion . Special attention is given to the Spotlight Showcases , which focus on themes like diversity and emerging food trends, and the RangeMe Collection , offering exclusive previews of up-and-coming brands. A standout feature of the show is the lineup of live competitions and award ceremonies. The SFA People Awards honor exceptional individuals in the industry, while the North America Pastry Competition Championship brings together eight chef teams for a sustainability-focused pastry showdown – a must-see event for anyone passionate about the future of dessert cuisine. The show connects manufacturers, distributors, importers, retailers, restaurateurs, and investors with the aim of unlocking new business opportunities, strengthening existing partnerships, and fostering targeted innovation. In just three days, attendees can establish valuable contacts, build collaborations, and close tangible business deals – efficiently, purposefully, and with an eye toward the future. For anyone looking to experience the latest in the food industry, spot trends early, and soak up the energy of New York’s culinary scene, the Summer Fancy Food Show is the place to be – unique, relevant, and truly inspiring.

The Castle & Garden Fair is an annual experiential event that transforms the park of Trebsen Castle, near Leipzig, into a stylish world of garden culture, modern country living, and aesthetic home design. Organized by Arcos GmbH, the fair takes place in late summer—typically in August—and appeals to discerning garden enthusiasts, design lovers, and connoisseurs seeking something special, both outdoors and at home. What makes the Castle & Garden Fair truly unique is not only the impressive setting of the late Gothic four-winged castle and its expansive park grounds but also the carefully curated selection of exhibitors, known for their expertise and passion for quality. Here, historical charm meets contemporary lifestyle, creating an inspiring experience that goes far beyond a traditional plant market. At the heart of the fair are the latest gardening trends, creative design ideas for home and garden, and culinary delights with a regional flair. Visitors can discover rare and exclusive plants—from exquisite roses and alpine species to heirloom tomato varieties—and receive expert advice on garden design, outdoor décor, and sustainable care. High-quality garden furniture, elegant accessories, stainless steel grill fireplaces, and whirlpools demonstrate how outdoor spaces can be transformed into personal havens of relaxation. The fair also offers plenty of inspiration for interiors. Handmade jewelry, one-of-a-kind porcelain pieces, select textiles, and fashion accessories round out a thoughtfully curated lifestyle offering. Regional artisans and culinary vendors provide gourmet treats, fine wines, and inventive food concepts for enjoyable breaks. Exhibitors represent the fields of horticulture, design, craftsmanship, culinary arts, and lifestyle. They embody quality, personal consultation, and authenticity—attributes that attract a wide audience: gardening enthusiasts, interior designers, gourmets, industry professionals from retail and gastronomy, as well as creative self-starters. Trebsen Castle is located in the Leipzig district, nestled in a scenic river landscape, and is easily accessible via the A14 motorway or by train through the nearby Grimma station. For one weekend each year, this historic site becomes a vibrant hub of stylish garden and lifestyle culture—a must-visit for anyone who wants to experience and create with all their senses.

The Foire aux Vins d’Alsace – the Alsace Wine Fair – is much more than a traditional trade or consumer exhibition. It uniquely blends wine culture, business, music, and regional identity, transforming the city of Colmar each summer since 1948 into a vibrant center of cultural and economic life in Alsace. The abbreviation FAV, short for Foire aux Vins d’Alsace , reflects the event’s core theme: Alsatian wine in all its diversity, quality, and tradition. The event takes place at the modern Parc des Expositions de Colmar, which becomes a ten-day magnet for wine enthusiasts, professionals, music lovers, and families every July or August. Organized by Colmar Expo SA in close cooperation with the Chamber of Commerce and the City of Colmar, this prominent event was originally created to revitalize the regional wine industry in the aftermath of World War II. Today, it ranks among the most significant summer festivals in France, drawing attention well beyond the borders of Alsace. At the heart of the fair are the Wines of Alsace, showcased in a dedicated wine trade exhibition featuring more than 1,500 samples, expert tastings, specialist lectures, and the ceremonial election of the Reine des Vins d’Alsace. This sensory experience is complemented by a diverse range of exhibitors—around 350 businesses from sectors such as crafts, fashion, horticulture, gastronomy, mobility, construction, and lifestyle. What sets the Foire aux Vins d’Alsace apart is its unique combination of trade fair, wine festival, and concert venue. International artists take to the open-air stage, creating a festival atmosphere with performances ranging from pop and rock to electronic and hard rock. Additional entertainment—ranging from burlesque and dance performances to children’s programs, cooking shows, and athletic displays—ensures a varied experience for a wide audience. The fair attracts not only trade visitors and business travelers, but also tourists, wine and music lovers, and culture enthusiasts from across France, the German-speaking regions, and beyond. Deeply rooted in the region, the FAV presents itself as a vibrant showcase of Alsatian lifestyle—a platform that unites economic vitality with cultural tradition and expresses regional pride through a celebration of enjoyment. The Parc des Expositions is conveniently located and easily accessible by car, train, or via nearby airports. Colmar itself, a charming and historic town nestled among the vineyards of Alsace, offers with its architecture and hospitality the perfect setting for a fair that brings the spirit of the region to life year after year.

개최장소(베뉴): Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre
축제소개: The HKTDC Food Expo is Asia’s leading trade and public exhibition for food and gastronomy. It takes place every August at the renowned Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, one of the city’s most iconic landmarks. The event is organized by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC), a key institution dedicated to promoting international trade and Hong Kong’s economic development. The expo serves as a forward-looking platform that brings together the entire spectrum of the food market under one roof. Its clearly defined sections ensure remarkable diversity. The Food Expo is reserved exclusively for industry professionals, focusing on innovation, technological advancements, and international sourcing. The Public Hall and the exclusive Gourmet Zone invite the general public to shop and discover culinary highlights. The HKTDC Food Expo showcases premium products, everyday classics, and specialties from around the globe, while also addressing current trends such as alternative proteins, 3D food printing, and intelligent packaging solutions. The range of products extends from branded delicacies, organic and wellness items, snacks, confectionery, pasta, ready meals, and beverages to halal foods, meat, seafood, dairy products, and plant-based alternatives. The thematic scope reflects Hong Kong’s global and cultural diversity: Asian and Western delicacies, vegetarian and vegan specialties, coffee, tea, craft beer, fine wines, health and nutrition products, innovative food tech solutions, as well as numerous OEM and private label offerings are all in focus. A comprehensive supporting program featuring cooking shows, live tastings, expert talks, and award ceremonies sets new standards each year and creates memorable culinary experiences. The expo is a central meeting point for decision-makers and trendsetters from retail, wholesale, import, export, gastronomy, and hospitality. Exhibitors and visitors represent every segment of the international food and beverage industry, including manufacturers, distributors, buyers, and food enthusiasts. Together with concurrent events such as the Hong Kong International Tea Fair and the HKTDC Home Delights Expo, the HKTDC Food Expo forms the centerpiece of Hong Kong’s vibrant exhibition scene. The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre impresses with its modern infrastructure and excellent public transport connections, ensuring a comfortable and efficient experience for all participants. The Food Expo is thus not only an international industry gathering, but also a significant driver of Hong Kong’s economic vitality and innovative spirit.

The Gourmet Festival , founded in 2011, is much more than a traditional food fair. It represents a unique, plant-based gourmet and lifestyle experience in the heart of the city. The festival’s name stands for culinary sophistication, sustainable living, and contemporary enjoyment, bringing together exclusive cuisine and inspiring culinary artistry in a special way. Once a year, the renowned Königsallee—Düsseldorf’s lively promenade—becomes a magnet for gourmets, food enthusiasts, industry experts, and all those who appreciate an innovative, vegan-oriented lifestyle. The festival is organized by Wellfairs GmbH, a renowned company known for its professional event management and keen sense of current food trends. The event serves as a platform for exceptional products and services: visitors discover plant-based alternatives to meat, fish, dairy, and cheese, as well as creative snacks, exclusive delicacies, vegan cosmetics, sustainable fashion, and modern kitchen and household appliances. The offerings are further enriched by contributions from the fields of sports, health, leisure, nutrition counseling, media, and literature, all of which together promote a forward-thinking lifestyle. The festival maintains a strong connection to Düsseldorf and the surrounding region. Many exhibitors come from the local area, highlighting the event’s deep roots within the city. Regional specialties, innovative street food concepts, and the inclusion of emerging businesses create a modern, creative atmosphere at the festival. The event appeals to both private gourmets and professional visitors, including decision-makers and trendsetters from gastronomy, hospitality, and retail. As part of a regional event series that also takes place in cities such as Mönchengladbach and Cologne, the Düsseldorf festival sets its own distinctive accents. What makes this event in the center of one of Germany’s most dynamic cities truly special is the combination of top-class cuisine, modern lifestyle, and an urban atmosphere. Its central location on the Königsallee ensures easy accessibility, whether by public transport or by car. The Gourmet Festival Düsseldorf, held annually as a leading trade fair, embodies enjoyment, sustainability, and innovation. Deeply rooted in the city’s way of life, it inspires both visitors and exhibitors with new ideas and current culinary trends.

개최장소(베뉴): Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center
축제소개: FoodEx Cambodia (Food Exhibition Cambodia) is the leading trade fair for the food and beverage industry in Cambodia. Held annually at the Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center (DIECC) in Phnom Penh, the event is organized by VEAS Co., Ltd. It is specifically designed for professionals from the retail, manufacturing, hospitality, and food service sectors who are seeking insights into the latest trends, technologies, and products in food, packaging, and processing. What sets FoodEx Cambodia apart is its clear focus on the needs of the Southeast Asian market, combined with an international outlook. The exhibition showcases a wide range of food products – from fresh fruits and vegetables, meat and poultry, and seafood to dairy products, delicacies, beverages, dietary supplements, and organic foods. This diverse offering is complemented by state-of-the-art food processing technologies, specialized machinery, innovative packaging solutions, as well as refrigeration and storage systems. Equipment for restaurants, hotels, and large-scale kitchens is also on display, making the fair a comprehensive platform that covers the entire value chain of the industry. The event reflects Cambodia’s economic growth and the increasing professionalization of its food and hospitality sectors. At the same time, it serves as an international hub for innovation and business development in a region marked by rising consumer awareness. Exhibitors from around the world – including food producers, machinery manufacturers, and packaging technology providers – connect with a highly engaged audience of importers, wholesalers, retail chains, hospitality professionals, investors, and key industry decision-makers. A core feature of the fair is its supporting program of conferences and seminars, where renowned industry experts share insights into current market developments, technological innovations, and sustainable solutions. Networking events and B2B matchmaking sessions add further value, establishing FoodEx Cambodia as a must-attend event on the industry calendar. The venue – the Diamond Island Convention and Exhibition Center – is centrally located on Koh Pich (Diamond Island) in Phnom Penh. Thanks to its convenient access via the international airport, major roads, and public transport, the exhibition center is easily reachable. With its modern infrastructure, spacious exhibition halls, and proximity to hotels and restaurants, the DIECC provides the ideal setting for an event of this scale.

Salón Chocolate y Cacao is Mexico’s leading trade fair dedicated to cocoa, chocolate, and related products. Held annually at the Pepsi Center next to the World Trade Center (WTC) in Mexico City, it is organized by the renowned event company Tradex Exposiciones . The fair targets industry professionals as well as connoisseurs of premium chocolate. The name “Salón Chocolate y Cacao” symbolizes the entire cocoa universe—from cultivation to the finished product—and brings together the key players in the sector. The event showcases the full value chain of chocolate production: from cocoa cultivation and processing to modern technologies, machinery, and innovative end products such as gourmet chocolate, pralines, chocolate art, and regional specialties. The focus extends beyond industrial solutions to include artisanal production, sustainability, and cultural diversity. As one of the few trade fairs worldwide, Salón Chocolate y Cacao unites indigenous producers with global technology leaders—a unique characteristic that sets it apart. A central objective of the event is to promote Mexico’s cocoa culture and highlight current market trends. As the birthplace of cocoa, Mexico plays a pivotal role. The fair serves as a cultural platform that bridges pre-Columbian traditions, contemporary developments, and the global significance of cocoa and chocolate. Trade visitors from sectors such as the confectionery industry, gastronomy, hospitality, patisserie, confectionery, packaging technology, and food processing meet exhibitors presenting a wide range of raw materials, ingredients, machinery, packaging solutions, and finished products. Exhibitors include both major international companies and specialized artisanal producers with exclusive offerings. Highlights of the fair include the Grand Prix de Chocolate, a competition recognizing outstanding chocolatiers, as well as creative presentations such as “Barbie in Chocolate” and fashion-inspired chocolate art under themes like “EAT ME” or “Supernova”. The trade show experience is further enriched by a diverse supporting program featuring expert talks, product demonstrations, tastings, and show formats covering topics such as chocolate and spirits pairings, historic beverages, and innovative packaging solutions. The visitor profile is as diverse as the fair itself: chocolatiers, chefs, pastry artists, buyers, retailers, designers, product developers, and marketing professionals from across the food industry attend Salón Chocolate y Cacao as a source of inspiration and a business platform. The venue—the modern and well-equipped Pepsi Center—is centrally located in Mexico City and easily accessible via public transportation or the city’s international airport. Situated near the World Trade Center and embedded in the cultural vibrancy of the capital, the location provides ideal conditions for networking, business opportunities, and enjoyment at the highest level.

The Gourmet Show is Mexico’s leading trade fair for premium food, fine beverages, and culinary lifestyle. Held annually in the heart of Mexico City – at the modern World Trade Center (WTC) – the event attracts culinary professionals, gourmet enthusiasts, and key decision-makers from across the food industry. Organized by Tradex Exposiciones, a seasoned exhibition company with decades of experience, the show has established itself as a benchmark in the sector. Each September, the Gourmet Show provides an exclusive platform for networking, presentation, and culinary exploration. Its clearly defined thematic structure, divided into dedicated exhibition zones known as Pabellones , offers visitors a well-organized experience while spotlighting industry trends and innovations. The Wine Room showcases international wines and premium spirits, while the Agave Fest is dedicated to traditional Mexican agave-based distillates such as tequila and mezcal. With Veganautas , the show also highlights the growing plant-based and vegan movement, reinforcing its commitment to culinary diversity and forward-thinking concepts. The product range is extensive – from artisanal breads, fine cheeses, and charcuterie to fresh seafood, gourmet chocolates, preserves, organic products, and creative culinary ingredients. The offering is further enriched by high-quality oils, vinegars, and international delicacies. Exhibitors include both small-scale producers and established brands from the fine food, gastronomy, hospitality, retail, wholesale, and catering sectors. Beyond business, the Gourmet Show embraces a cultural mission: to promote Mexico’s culinary heritage while bridging tradition and innovation. Through a diverse program of workshops, tastings, and networking events, it creates a vibrant meeting point for chefs, sommeliers, food professionals, and culinary enthusiasts. As Mexico’s premier culinary showcase, the event highlights the country’s rich diversity of products and producers – and in doing so, enhances its international reputation as a destination for gourmet excellence. The centrally located Pepsi Center also provides ideal infrastructure. Its proximity to the WTC, excellent public transport connections, and nearby hotel options make the Gourmet Show not only a culinary highlight but also a logistical success.

The SIAL China , which has been a leading international trade fair for food and beverages since its launch in 2023, will now be held annually at the Poly World Trade Center Expo in Guangzhou following its relocation from Shenzhen. The name SIAL stands for “Salon International de l’Alimentation”, meaning “International Food Exhibition”. The event is organised by Comexposium, a global organiser of trade fairs and conferences. The exhibition covers a wide range of sectors, including baby food, organic and wellness products, dairy products, non-alcoholic and alcoholic beverages, meat, poultry, processed meats and sausages, seafood, as well as pulses and cereals. This diversity highlights its central role as a platform for innovation and emerging trends within the food industry. At SIAL China, food manufacturers, distributors, importers, wholesalers, retailers, and representatives from both institutional and commercial foodservice showcase their latest products and services. As such, the trade fair serves as an important gateway to the Chinese market and a key platform for international companies seeking to establish a presence in China’s dynamic business environment. Distinctive features of the event include numerous competitions and award ceremonies recognising outstanding innovation, such as the SIAL Innovation competition, the SIAL Chic and Tea Contest, and the SIAL Cup Barista Challenge. These events promote quality and innovation while providing valuable opportunities for exchange between industry professionals and companies. As part of a global series of SIAL exhibitions, SIAL China plays a pivotal role in the international food industry. Participants and exhibitors represent a broad spectrum of sectors, including food production, foodservice, and trade. The Poly World Trade Center Expo in Guangzhou offers modern facilities and excellent infrastructure, making it an ideal venue for events of this scale and significance. Its convenient accessibility further enhances the trade fair’s appeal for both local and international participants.

Bellavita in Riga is the leading trade fair for Italian food and beverages in the Baltic region. As an exclusive centre of expertise, it showcases authentic culinary experiences from every region of Italy. Each year, it opens its doors at the International Exhibition Centre Kipsala in Riga to industry professionals from gastronomy, retail, and wholesale, who can explore the diversity and quality of Italian products here. Organised by Bellavita Expo Ltd., the fair—whose name stands for "the beautiful life" and the Italian way of living—combines outstanding culinary excellence with a high-quality, internationally oriented business network. The range of products on offer extends from classic specialities such as olive oil, wine, and cheese to innovative delicacies and convenience solutions, always with a focus on premium quality. A key feature is the international buyer and matchmaking programme, organised in cooperation with the Italian Trade Agency (ICE) and the partner fairs Cibus Parma and TuttoFood Milano. This structured format actively promotes connections between exhibitors and buyers from Central and Northern Europe, opening up new business opportunities in the Baltic market. Bellavita Expo also sees itself as a platform for knowledge transfer and industry trends. Blind tastings, competitions, and awards give producers the opportunity to have their products evaluated by experts. Exhibitors from the fields of wine, dairy products, meat and charcuterie, fish, fruit and vegetables, confectionery, and delicatessen meet a qualified audience from trade, gastronomy, and the international import and export sector. The trade fair is part of a successful, internationally expanding series of events that takes place not only in Riga but also at other locations worldwide. The modern Kipsala Exhibition Centre provides ideal conditions—from its central location to the inspiring atmosphere in Latvia's vibrant capital. Bellavita Expo Riga thus serves as the key platform for anyone wishing to experience Italian food trends, build business relationships, and discover premium products for the Baltic market. The Bellavita take place annually, and therefore presumably in September 2027 in Riga.

The " Fastener Fair Italy " is a key event in the world of connection and fastening technology, held at the prestigious Allianz MiCo Milano Convention Centre in Milan. This specialized trade fair, occurring biennially, is exclusively accessible to professionals in the field of fastening elements and technologies. Organized by RX Italy, the fair is established as an important part of the international network of Fastener Fairs. The fair serves as a comprehensive platform that spans from industrial fasteners and construction fixings to assembly and installation systems. Key topics include fastener manufacturing technologies, storage and distribution systems, and services ranging from material procurement to consumer consultation. Products showcased include nuts, screws, nails, bolts, raw materials, molding and forging processes, and coating treatments. Fastener Fair Italy stands out due to its specific focus and provides a platform for business development and networking. It presents innovative products and services from the fastening industry. Exhibitors from various industrial sectors such as automotive, mechanical engineering, electrical, and construction industries meet a broad audience of professionals, from wholesalers to manufacturers and end consumers. Thus, the fair is an essential interface for all participants involved in the production and use of fastening elements. Milan, as the host city, supports the fair not only through its infrastructure but also promotes the international orientation and accessibility of the event. The Allianz MiCo Milano Convention Centre, easily accessible and equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, is the ideal venue for this trade fair. In summary, Fastener Fair Italy is more than just a fair: it is a central hub for technology transfer, innovation, and business initiation in the fastening industry. Each edition offers new opportunities for networking, knowledge exchange, and the expansion of business relationships.

WineTech , the Australian Wine Industry Trade Exhibition, is the leading trade fair for Australia’s wine sector. Held every three years at the Adelaide Convention Centre, the event takes place in a state-of-the-art venue located in the heart of South Australia’s capital. Its central location offers convenient access to the airport, central train station, hotels, and restaurants. Over time, WineTech has established itself as a key platform for innovation, technology, and professional exchange within the industry. The name “WineTech” symbolically represents the intersection of wine production and technological advancement—an essential driver of the industry’s long-term viability. The exhibition is organised by Expertise Events Pty Ltd., a renowned Australian event organiser known for delivering high-impact, professional trade shows. Its triennial schedule ensures a steady stream of fresh ideas, technological breakthroughs, and practical solutions to both current and emerging challenges. At the core of WineTech are practical innovations in viticulture and oenology, spanning the entire production process—from vineyard management and modern winemaking technologies to sustainable packaging and bottling solutions. Exhibitors from fields such as automation, sensor technology, robotics, IoT, laboratory analytics, and microbiome science showcase their latest developments, alongside contributions from research institutions, life sciences, and agricultural technology. High-interest topics include precision viticulture, CO₂-reduced materials, data-driven processes, and climate-resilient cultivation methods. The exhibition is further enriched by high-level workshops, interactive floor talks, and the accompanying Australian Wine Industry Technical Conference. These formats create a unique knowledge platform that brings together hands-on professionals, scientists, and industry leaders. Visitors from across the entire value chain—from production to export—attend the event to gain insights, exchange ideas, and make informed investment decisions. WineTech is not a travelling exhibition but a firmly established event rooted in Adelaide. As the capital of South Australia—home to the country’s most productive wine-growing regions—Adelaide offers an ideal setting. Its proximity to renowned wineries, research centres, and innovative start-ups provides the perfect backdrop for a trade fair that embraces both tradition and transformation. Whether the goal is to future-proof operations, develop sustainable vineyards, or gain a competitive edge in global markets, WineTech offers a practical, inspiring, and unparalleled platform for actively shaping the future of the wine industry.
